# Design Spec Structure

Project-level `design_spec.md` is a human-readable English-heading Markdown artifact. This file owns its authoring structure; [`schemas/design_spec.schema.json`](./schemas/design_spec.schema.json) lints readable sections and page projection — it is not an execution lock and requires no textual equality with `spec_lock.md`. Strategist reads the final confirmation once, writes this artifact from that retained state plus source analysis, and audits every confirmed field here; `spec_lock.md` is then authored from the completed Design Spec plus context without reopening `result.json`.

## 1. Author the complete artifact

Compose the entire document in active context, then create `<project_path>/design_spec.md` once, first line through §X. **Depth follows the confirmed `design_spec_depth`** — `brief` (default) or `complete`; both keep every required heading and machine-read field. `brief` serves a continuous run whose author also draws the pages: §I records production mechanics without restating Stage-1 prose, §VI may leave the scenario column empty, §IX `Content` is a short block list (one bullet per block in the phrasing that fits — a sentence for prose, `·`-joined parallel fragments, `/`-joined labels — never full copy), and `Composition` is one optional line; `Relationships` is written at both depths. `complete` writes full wording and layout prose; split mode, `refine_spec: true`, and preservation profiles force it.

**Mandatory — new-project write**: the first non-empty line is exactly `<!-- ppt-master-schema: design-spec/v1 -->`, then `# <Project Name> - Design Spec`; every required section carries final values and the complete roster; conditional §VII appears only with a real catalog reference. Never write a placeholder-bearing file, copy example rows, or patch a scaffold field by field (`project_manager.py scaffold-spec` is an optional manual troubleshooting tool, not part of Generate authoring; resume and refine edit the existing completed Design Spec).

---

## 2. Exact document contract

Angle-bracketed text is authoring notation. Resolve every universal value before writing; omit only rows marked conditional; keep every required `##` heading (§VII is conditional: drop the whole section, heading included, when no page carries a catalog reference; §VIII present even with no data rows); copy no examples, notation, or schema prose into the artifact.

### 2.1 Header and project contract

```markdown
<!-- ppt-master-schema: design-spec/v1 -->
# <Project Name> - Design Spec

## I. Project Information

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Project Name | <resolved project name> |
| Canvas Format | <canonical format and dimensions> |
| Page Count | <exact final count matching §IX> |
| Primary Language | <confirmed canonical BCP-47 content tag> |
| Target Audience | <confirmed audience> |
| Communication Intent | <confirmed intent, including priority or sequence> |
| Desired Audience Outcome | <confirmed observable outcome> |
| Core Message / Ask / Action | <confirmed core message or ask> |
| Delivery Context | <confirmed delivery context> |
| Artifact Afterlife | <confirmed afterlife> |
| Reading Mode | <text, balanced, presentation, or the active non-PPT equivalent> |
| Content Strategy | <confirmed material-divergence prose or balanced default> |
| Design Style | <resolved design direction> |
| AI Image Acquisition Path | <confirmed path or not applicable> |
| Generation Mode | <continuous or split> |
| Spec Refinement | <enabled or disabled> |
| Speaker Notes | <enabled or disabled> — <explicit user instruction, final Stage-2 proactive policy, workflow default, or enabled Narration Audio dependency> |
| Custom Animations | <enabled or disabled> — <explicit instruction and object/all-motion scope, final Stage-2 proactive policy, or workflow default> |
| Narration Audio | <enabled or disabled> — <explicit user instruction, final Stage-2 proactive policy, or workflow default> |
| Created Date | <YYYY-MM-DD> |

## II. Canvas Specification

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Format | <canonical format name> |
| Dimensions | <width × height> |
| viewBox | `<exact viewBox>` |
| Margins | <safe margins> |
| Content Area | <usable bounds> |
```

With an active template workspace, append exactly one line after the §I table — `- **Template Application**: <confirmed or Strategist-resolved natural-language plan>` — never internal reuse/adherence ids; omit it for free design.

### 2.2 Visual, typography, layout, and icons

```markdown
## III. Visual Theme

### Theme Style

- **Mode**: <confirmed preset or custom>
- **Visual style**: <confirmed preset or custom>
- **Theme**: <resolved identity direction>
- **Tone**: <resolved tone>

### Color Scheme

| Role | HEX | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Background | <HEX> | <semantic use> |
| Secondary background | <HEX> | <semantic use> |
| Primary | <HEX> | <semantic use> |
| Accent | <HEX> | <semantic use> |
| Secondary accent | <HEX> | <semantic use> |
| Body text | <HEX> | <semantic use> |
| Secondary text | <HEX> | <captions, annotations, footnotes> |
| Divider | <HEX> | <rules, borders, hairlines> |

## IV. Typography System

### Font Plan

| Role | Character (Reference) | Primary | English if non-English | Fallback tail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Title | <category/modifier> | <family> | <family> | <fallback> |
| Body | <category/modifier> | <family> | <family> | <fallback> |

- **Typography upgrade (Reference)**: <post-export role substitution after target installation; omit if none>
- **Title stack**: <complete ordered stack>
- **Body stack**: <complete ordered stack>

### Font Size Hierarchy

| Purpose | Anchor Size (px) |
| --- | ---: |
| Body | <confirmed value> |
| Title | <confirmed value> |
| Subtitle | <confirmed value> |
| Annotation | <confirmed value> |

## V. Layout Principles

### Deck-wide Direction

- **Hierarchy direction**: <how attention should move across a typical page>
- **Composition tendency**: <non-binding macro direction; no coordinates or authoring method>
- **Cross-page continuity**: <what may recur or vary across the roster>
- **Spacing posture**: <dense, open, or variable by page rhythm>
- **Spacing anchors**: <five deck-wide px values — page margin, block gap, column gutter, corner radius, body leading — kept stable like the color and type anchors>

## VI. Icon Usage Specification

- **Primary bundled library**: <one of chunk-filled / tabler-filled / tabler-outline / phosphor-duotone, or none>
- **Brand-logo library**: <simple-icons when actual content requires prepared real brand marks; omit otherwise>

| Icon Path | Suitable Scenarios |
| --- | --- |
```

Preserve Title/Body characters and resolved stacks; omit a blank Typography upgrade and never place it in a stack. Each justified recurring family override adds its role to Font Plan plus `- **<Role> stack**: <complete ordered stack>` (roles such as `Display`, `Annotation`, `Footer`, `Footnote`, `Data`, `Emphasis`, `Quote`, `Code`, or any descriptive recurring role the deck needs — a second monospace role like `Index` is valid — only recurring, intentional differences; `Display` covers hero numerals and oversized titles that leave the Title family; a non-locked `Role rationale` only for an extra family); never collapse distinct Title/Body stacks or drop a declared role. Each Font Size Hierarchy value is a deck-wide role anchor; Executor's band and display exception are [`executor-base.md`](../references/executor-base.md) §2.1, so every recurring role is named here. Record every recurring palette role and size anchor the plan establishes, never one-off garnish. For confirmed custom directions add `Mode References`, `Mode Behavior`, `Visual Style References`, and `Visual Style Behavior` under Theme Style as applicable. `Stroke Width` under §VI only for a stroke library. `simple-icons` rows follow the brand-mark rule in the [icon README](../templates/icons/README.md). The §VI table records the synced SVG pool and, at `complete` depth, broad scenarios — never page placement; leave it empty when no bundled or brand icons are prepared. Other prepared SVGs under the project `icons/` remain usable without entering that selection. Illustrated icons are AI image resources: their sheet and placed slice rows belong in §VIII, and only placed slices project to `spec_lock.md images`.

When §VIII contains any `Acquire Via: ai` row, add under §III:

```markdown
### AI Image Strategy

- **Image Rendering**: <confirmed preset or custom>
- **Visual**: <confirmed visual treatment>
- **Mood**: <confirmed mood and analogy>
```

A custom rendering adds `Image Rendering Behavior`, and `Image Rendering References` only when catalog material is actually used; never a separate image palette.

### 2.3 Visualization and image resources

```markdown
## VII. Visualization Reference List

| Page | Family | Template | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

## VIII. Image Resource List

| Filename | Dimensions | Ratio | Purpose | Type | Image pattern | Crop Policy | Acquire Via | Status | Reference | text_policy | page_role |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
```

§VII lists at most one `chart|table` reference per page (canonical `family/key` plus semantic Usage; omit when empty; legacy rows stay readable, new specs use four columns). §IX owns child visuals and unmatched fallbacks in `Visualization`; qualitative relationships live only on the `Relationships` line; Layout/Deck alone owns reusable PowerPoint structure. One ordered Slide block per page; count and order equal §I `Page Count`; `Content` is a complete brief at `complete` depth and a short block list at `brief` — never a skeleton.

- **Relationships**: <the page's semantic units and the source-stated order / link / parent / membership / contrast / overlap among them, or none; no shape, carrier, or authoring words>
- **Composition**: <Reference — macro composition, hierarchy, and visual focus as a starting sketch; chosen prototype when template-active; optional at brief depth>
- **Title**: <preferred page title>
- **Core message**: <one governing assertion>
- **Content**: <complete content at complete depth; short block list at brief depth>
- **Mathematical content**: <exact expression as a delimiter-free LaTeX body; omit when none>

- **Generation**: <enabled or disabled>
- **Filename**: match each SVG filename under `notes/`
- **Content**: <notes content and source-handling policy>
- **Total duration**: <resolved duration>
- **Notes style**: <formal, conversational, interactive, or resolved equivalent>
- **Presentation purpose**: <the confirmed communication intent from §I>

## 3. Machine validation

`python3 skills/ppt-master/scripts/project_manager.py validate <project_path>` reads the Markdown directly and reports missing or out-of-order I–X sections, unresolved `[fill...]` placeholders, missing per-slide `Audience move` or `Relationships` lines, and a missing §III `AI Image Strategy` when §VIII selects `ai`. The schema validates structure only; Strategist modules own meaning, and `spec_lock.md` owns stable anchors and routing, not an exhaustive projection. On divergence, repair the Design Spec from the retained final state when Gate 1 fails, then re-author affected lock anchors; never reopen `result.json` to author the lock or let the lock overwrite a valid Design Spec decision.

# Execution Lock Structure

`spec_lock.md` projects cross-page anchors and routes from the audited `design_spec.md` and context; it excludes local paint/type. This file owns structure; [`schemas/spec_lock.schema.json`](./schemas/spec_lock.schema.json) owns grammar.

## 1. Author the complete artifact

After Generate Step 4 Gate 1, read the completed Design Spec and current page/resource/template context, compose the entire lock in active context, and create `<project_path>/spec_lock.md` once. **Mandatory — new-project write**: the first non-empty line is exactly `<!-- ppt-master-schema: spec-lock/v1 -->`, then `# Execution Lock`; write only final sections and values — no blank lock, inactive optional sections, or scaffold placeholders (`project_manager.py scaffold-lock` is an optional troubleshooting tool); never reopen or reinterpret final confirmation. Repair a credible completed pair by re-projecting only the affected rows after auditing the Design Spec; discard an orphan lock as authority and re-author it completely from the recovered Design Spec.

**Hard rule**: a lock contains only `##` sections and `- key: value` lines, except `## forbidden`, whose items are literal rules; never copy guidance paragraphs into it.

---

## 2. Base sections

| Section | Required keys | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `canvas` | `viewBox`, `format` | `format` is the Format column of [`canvas-formats.md`](../references/canvas-formats.md) (e.g. `PPT 16:9`) or the format ID; `viewBox` the exact geometry |
| `communication` | `primary_language`, `audience`, `objective`, `core_message` | Canonical BCP-47 (reject `und` and Chinese without script/region; old locks may omit it); `objective` merges intent/outcome; `consumption_mode` optional off PPT |
| `mode` | `mode` | Preset or `custom` |
| `visual_style` | `visual_style` | Preset or `custom` |
| `colors` | Stable semantic color roles | Core identity and recurring roles only, including `secondary_text` and `divider`; contextual paints need no row; `image_rendering` only for AI images |
| `typography` | `font_family`, `body`, `title` | Core family/size anchors; new locks also write `title_family` and `body_family`; sizes are unitless px |
| `icons` | `library`, `inventory` | `library` is the primary bundled style or `none`; `simple-icons/*` may be prepared alone or alongside it; `inventory` indexes the curated synced pool, not page usage or every usable project icon; `stroke_width` conditional |
| `page_rhythm` | One `P<NN>` row per page | `anchor`, `dense`, `breathing` |
| `pptx_structure` | `mode` | `flat`, `structured` |
| `forbidden` | Literal list items | The technical baseline rows stay untagged; every other row is a prohibition the user stated in their own words (request, chat, `image_notes`), quoted verbatim and ending with `(user)`; nothing else enters — general standards stay in their owning reference, a template's rules stay in its installed spec, and a confirmed `visual_style_behavior` binds as identity prose without becoming a lock row |

Optional data sections: `images`, `page_visualizations` (Chart/Table only). New locks never write legacy `page_charts` (existing locks may keep it read-only); never declare one page in both.

```markdown
## forbidden
- `mask`, `<style>`, `class`, external CSS, `<foreignObject>`, `textPath`, `@font-face`, `<animate*>`, `<set>`, `<script>` / event attributes, `<iframe>`
- HTML named entities in text; write typography as raw Unicode and escape XML reserved characters
- 不要用任何阴影和发光 (user)
```

A `(user)` row is the user's sentence, not a paraphrase and never widened; a Strategist-drafted direction — even once confirmed — is identity prose in `visual_style_behavior`, not a prohibition, so nothing is projected from it into this section. `project_manager.py validate` rejects an untagged non-baseline row.

| Trigger | Required addition |
| --- | --- |
| `mode.mode: custom` | `mode_behavior`; optional `mode_references` only when catalog modes are used |
| `visual_style.visual_style: custom` | `visual_style_behavior`; optional `visual_style_references` |
| `colors.image_rendering: custom` | `image_rendering_behavior`; optional `image_rendering_references` |
| `icons.library: tabler-outline` | `stroke_width: 1.5`, `2`, or `3` |
| `pptx_structure.mode: structured` | `template_reuse_scope: layout\|mirror`, `template_adherence`, plus `pptx_masters`, `pptx_layouts`, `page_pptx_layouts`, `page_layouts` |
| `template_reuse_scope: mirror` | `mode: structured` and `template_adherence: strict` |
| `template_reuse_scope: style` | `mode: flat`; omit structured sections |
| `pptx_structure.mode: flat` | Omit all four structured sections |

Typography projection (excluding Character/upgrade References): Title font stack → `title_family`; Body font stack → `body_family` plus compatibility `font_family`; each additional recurring role `<role>` → `<role>_family`; each Font Size Hierarchy role → lowercase snake_case `<role>` with its numeric anchor. New locks always write `title_family` and `body_family` even when equal; omit only family roles that inherit without an override; old locks fall back to `font_family`.

---

## 4. Field Grammar Index

- `font_family`, `title_family`, `body_family`, and every `<role>_family`: one non-empty PPT-safe exported family stack; `font_family` is the body/default compatibility stack, not permission to erase role differences.
- Every non-family `typography` value: a positive finite unitless px anchor; Executor's band and display exception are [`executor-base.md`](../references/executor-base.md) §2.1, and the extension rule is §6.
- `icons.library`: `chunk-filled`, `tabler-filled`, `tabler-outline`, `phosphor-duotone`, or `none`; `simple-icons/*` marks may appear alone or alongside in `inventory` without becoming a library or confirmation choice; every SVG under `<project_path>/icons/` remains valid material; illustrated-icon slices create no icon field — their paths belong under `images`, and the unplaced sheet stays out.
- `objective`: one concise sentence preserving goal and audience success condition.
- `image_rendering`: one catalog id, or `custom` with `image_rendering_behavior`.
- `images`: `- <key>: <path> | source=<via> | crop=<adaptive|no-crop>` (e.g. `- p04: images/a.png | source=user | crop=no-crop`); canonical `images/<filename>` path; `source` and `crop` project §VIII exactly; `Image pattern` is not projected (Executor reads it from §VIII as a recommendation); a legacy `pattern=<layout>` segment is accepted; omit unplaced sheets.
- Custom reference fields: comma-separated exact catalog ids without duplicates, valid only for `custom`; omit for a genuinely novel direction.
- `stroke_width`: `1.5`, `2`, or `3`, only for `tabler-outline`.
- `page_rhythm`: `P` + at least two digits (`P01`, `P100`) followed by `anchor|dense|breathing`.
- `page_visualizations`: `P` + at least two digits followed by `chart|table`, `/`, and one canonical key resolving to one SVG through the matching live index. Legacy `page_charts`: `P` + at least two digits and one bare key; never added to a new lock.
- `pptx_masters`: `<master_key>: <PowerPoint picker name>`. `pptx_layouts`: `<layout_key>: <master_key> | <PowerPoint layout name> | <prototype source>`. `page_pptx_layouts`: `P` + at least two digits followed by a declared Layout key. `page_layouts`: `P` + at least two digits followed by a complete Slide template SVG basename; definition-only `layout_<layout_key>` files are obsolete and invalid as sources.

```markdown
## mode
- mode: custom
- mode_references: pyramid, narrative, instructional
- mode_behavior: Open conclusion-first with pyramid, develop the risk through a narrative tension-and-resolution act, then close with an instructional action sequence.
```

---

## 5. Machine Validation

`python3 skills/ppt-master/scripts/project_manager.py validate <project_path>` reports unresolved `[fill...]` placeholders, wrong casing, unknown sections or fields, illegal enums, malformed page keys, missing catalog assets, broken structured-layout references, and unmet conditions; it neither rewrites the lock nor checks semantic projection (Gate 2 does). Field meaning stays in the Strategist modules; Executor branches own consumption; the schema owns grammar and structural conditions only.

## 6. Anchor and extension semantics

Confirmed core palette roles and every declared typography family/size role are stable cross-page anchors. Page-local tints, gradient stops, shadow/glow paints, transparency composites, and one-off export-safe display families may be authored from context without a row; the size band and display exception Executor works within are [`executor-base.md`](../references/executor-base.md) §2.1. When a contextual value becomes a recurring semantic role, or an undeclared display size reaches its third occurrence, add the descriptive role, read back and validate affected planning fragments, then reuse it; structural typography outside its band returns upstream immediately. Never expand the lock merely to empty an informational checker comparison — a lock edit expresses reuse or identity, not incidental literals.

# 老旧小区改造工作情况汇报 - Design Spec

## I. Project Information

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Project Name | old_community_renovation_report（老旧小区改造工作情况汇报） |
| Canvas Format | PPT 16:9（1280 × 720） |
| Page Count | 13 |
| Primary Language | zh-CN |
| Target Audience | 政府评审组：老旧小区改造工作专项评审专家、区（市）政府分管领导及住建、财政、审计等部门负责人；熟悉改造政策与专项资金管理规则，逐页核数、关注口径一致性与问题真实性 |
| Communication Intent | 首先按用户给定纲目逐项汇报并说明责任（改造任务完成情况 → 资金使用情况 → 居民满意度），以统一口径的数据证明任务真实完成、资金合规使用、群众认可；其次主动暴露问题并把每个问题回溯到前述资金与满意度的具体比率，使评审组一眼看清问题来源；最后提出逐条对应问题的整改措施与三项提请审议事项，争取评审通过 |
| Desired Audience Outcome | 评审组确认三项核心指标（小区完工率 92.6%、资金到位率 90.0%、居民满意度 93.8%）口径统一、数据可核；认可五个问题均有资金或满意度数据出处、定位准确；同意七项整改措施的目标值与时限，并对三项提请审议事项（追加区级配套 2140 万元、5 个在建小区竣工时限调整至 2026 年 11 月底、管线单位共建共担机制纳入市级文件）作出通过决定 |
| Core Message / Ask / Action | 三年改造任务总体完成九成以上，资金到位率 90.0%、支出执行率 86.0%，居民满意度 93.8%；尚未闭合的 4280 万元资金缺口与三个低于 90% 的满意度短板维度，就是全部五个问题的来源；下一步以七项措施把五项比率推到 100%、100%、98% 以上、100%、95% 以上，提请评审组审议三项事项 |
| Delivery Context | 主讲人现场汇报为主（评审会会议室投影，20—25 分钟，含专家质询）；次要用途为会后送审留档、专家逐项核数与整改督办比对 |
| Artifact Afterlife | 评审留档与审计核查依据；作为整改台账与后续督办比对基线，需支持逐页核对数据来源与统计口径 |
| Reading Mode | balanced |
| Content Strategy | 用户纲目为权威结构（binding）：五个小标题的措辞与顺序不得改动、不得合并或交叉装填，每个小标题下的内容只能服务于该标题；在此约束下可细分二级页面、补充表格与口径说明。事实来源仅限用户纲目与本次汇报口径，所有数值为 scenario 数据（见各页 Data class），不得引入外部未经核实的数据 |
| Design Style | 方向一「公文评审体」：mode custom（briefing + pyramid）、visual_style custom（swiss-minimal + data-journalism）；严格左对齐栅格、宋体标题 + 雅黑正文、深藏青主色 + 赭金章节标记、语义色标注达标/滞后、每页脚注固定标注数据来源与统计口径 |
| AI Image Acquisition Path | not applicable（image_usage: none，本环境无网络与图像生成能力） |
| Generation Mode | continuous |
| Spec Refinement | disabled |
| Speaker Notes | enabled — workflow default（Stage-2 proactive_speaker_notes: true），现场汇报需讲稿支撑质询环节 |
| Custom Animations | disabled — Stage-2 proactive_custom_animations: false |
| Narration Audio | disabled — Stage-2 proactive_narration_audio: false |
| Created Date | 2026-09-23 |

## II. Canvas Specification

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Format | PPT 16:9（ppt169） |
| Dimensions | 1280 × 720 |
| viewBox | `0 0 1280 720` |
| Margins | 上 52 / 下 44 / 左 64 / 右 64 |
| Content Area | x 64–1216，y 52–676（1152 × 624）；页眉带 y 52–96，页脚带 y 648–676 |

## III. Visual Theme

### Theme Style

- **Mode**: custom
- **Mode References**: briefing, pyramid
- **Mode Behavior**: 公文化汇报体。每页以一句判断句（结论前置，源自 pyramid）统领本页事实，随后按公文条目化方式完整、均衡、可扫读地铺陈数据、表格与口径说明（源自 briefing），不作渲染性论述、不设悬念；页面标题一律使用"（一）（二）"式公文章节题名；末章集中提出审议请求与目标口径，形成"结论—依据—问题—措施—审议"的闭环。
- **Visual style**: custom
- **Visual Style References**: swiss-minimal, data-journalism
- **Visual Style Behavior**: 严格左对齐栅格与 1px 细分隔线，无阴影、无发光、无圆角堆叠（圆角 2px）、无装饰性图形与插画。页眉为"章节编号 + 章名 + 页码"的公文式页眉带（赭金编号、深藏青章名、下缘 1px 分隔线），页脚为"数据来源 + 统计口径 + 数据截至日"的来源行（源自 data-journalism 的 source line 传统）。数据一律以原生表格与条形/瀑布几何呈现，白底为主、浅灰面板为辅，语义色仅用于状态判定（达标/基本达标/滞后），版面留白充裕但信息密度按页承载完整判断句与依据。
- **Theme**: 政务评审公文风——深藏青为结构主色、赭金为章节标记、宋体标题压阵、数据可逐格核对
- **Tone**: 庄重、克制、可核、不渲染；主动亮问题、逐条给出处

### Color Scheme

| Role | HEX | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Background | #FFFFFF | 页面底色 |
| Secondary background | #F3F5F7 | 面板底、表格隔行、页眉/页脚带底 |
| Primary | #16324F | 深藏青：主标题、结构线、图表主色、封面底 |
| Accent | #C8A45C | 赭金：章节编号、页眉细线、深色底上的强调与大号数字（仅用于深底或≥20px，不用于白底小字） |
| Accent deep | #8C6D3F | 白底上的赭金文字/细线（对比度≥4.5:1 的可用金） |
| Secondary accent | #4A7BA7 | 中蓝：图表次系列、次要结构块、对照数据 |
| Body text | #1A1D21 | 正文 |
| Secondary text | #5B6672 | 注释、口径说明、脚注、来源行 |
| Divider | #D3D9DF | 分隔线、表格框线、面板边 |
| Surface | #FFFFFF | 卡片/表格面板 lifting 面（配 1px Divider 边，不用阴影） |
| Grid | #E6EAEF | 图表网格线、浅于 Divider 的辅助线 |
| Positive | #2E7D32 | 达标（完成率/满意度 ≥95%）、目标达成 |

| Negative | #C0392B | 滞后/短板（<90%）、资金缺口、未办结、问题标注 |

## IV. Typography System

### Font Plan

| Role | Character (Reference) | Primary | English if non-English | Fallback tail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Title | 公文式衬线中文标题，庄重、正式、有权威性 | SimSun | Times New Roman | serif |
| Body | 现代无衬线中文正文，投影与印刷均清晰 | Microsoft YaHei | Arial | sans-serif |

- **Title stack**: `SimSun, Times New Roman`
- **Body stack**: `Microsoft YaHei, Arial`
- **Role rationale**: 不新增第三字族；KPI 大数字与表格数值沿用 Body 栈（Arial 提供等宽线性数字），仅以尺寸与字重区分角色。

### Font Size Hierarchy

| Purpose | Anchor Size (px) |

| Cover title | 68 |
| KPI number | 52 |
| Title | 40 |
| Section label | 20 |
| Subtitle | 30 |
| Lead | 28 |
| Body | 24 |
| Table data | 22 |
| Annotation | 18 |
| Footnote | 16 |

## V. Layout Principles

### Deck-wide Direction

- **Hierarchy direction**: 页眉章节带（定位）→ 页标题与判断句（本页结论）→ 主数据区（表格/图表/KPI）→ 口径与状态注解 → 页脚来源行；视线自上而下、自左而右，结论先于依据。
- **Composition tendency**: 内容页以"左结论右依据"或"上判断句下数据面"为主；数据页优先整版表格或整版条形几何，配一条窄侧栏放口径说明；问题页采用"问题—数据溯源—影响"三段式对应结构，使来源指向可读。
- **Cross-page continuity**: 每页复用同一页眉带（赭金章节编号"一、二、三、四、五" + 章名 + 右上页码）与同一页脚来源行（数据来源 / 统计口径 / 数据截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日）；章节编号与状态色为跨页记忆锚。
- **Spacing posture**: variable by page rhythm（dense 页表格与注解紧凑、breathing 页留白加倍、anchor 页大字号居中偏左）
- **Spacing anchors**: page margin 64 / block gap 28 / column gutter 24 / corner radius 2 / body leading 37

## VII. Visualization Reference List

- **Title**: 老旧小区改造工作情况汇报

- **Content**:

  - 副标题：2023—2025 年改造任务实施情况 · 提请评审组审议

  - 钩子行：小区完工率 92.6% ｜ 资金到位率 90.0% ｜ 居民满意度 93.8%

#### Slide 10 - 四、存在问题（一）：资金保障与支出进度方面

- **Audience move**: 从"等待被指出问题"到"看到两个资金类问题均由汇报方主动列出，并逐条标注第二部分的具体比率与金额出处"
- **Relationships**: 问题一、问题二为并列（同属资金方面）；每个问题下"问题表现—数据溯源—造成影响"为 parent→membership 且三段为 order；数据溯源与 P05、P06 的资金比率为 link；造成影响与 P03、P04 的完成率为 link
- **Composition**: 上下两块问题带，每块内部左为问题编号与题名、中为问题表现与数据溯源（引用具体比率并标注出处页）、右为造成影响；块底一条细线指向"来源：第二部分 资金使用情况"
- **Title**: 存在问题（一）：资金保障与支出进度方面
- **Core message**: 两个资金类问题分别来自"到位率 90.0% 的渠道结构"与"支出执行率 86.0% 的进度差"，均可回溯至 P05、P06 数据
- **Content**:
  - 判断句：资金方面的两个问题，一个出在来源结构、一个出在支出进度，直接影响了完工率与提升类任务。
  - 问题一：多元筹资渠道尚未闭合，区级配套与社会、居民出资到位率偏低
  - 问题一数据溯源（P06）：区级财政配套到位率 81.8%（缺口 2140 万元）、管线单位及社会资本到位率 73.0%（缺口 1140 万元）、居民出资到位率 65.8%（缺口 1000 万元），而中央、省级、市级三级补助资金到位率均为 100.0%
  - 问题一造成影响（P03、P04）：整体资金到位率 90.0%；5 个在建小区中 4 个因资金未闭合缓建，直接使小区完工率停在 92.6%
  - 问题二：支出进度滞后于到位进度，结余资金沉淀未形成实物工作量
  - 问题二数据溯源（P05、P06）：支出执行率 86.0%，账面积余 5393 万元、结余率 14.0%；分类支出执行率提升类 75.9%、完善类与前期及管理费 86.0%、基础设施类 89.6%；5393 万元中 3236 万元因竣工结算审计未完成暂不能拨付，占结余 60.0%
  - 问题二造成影响（P04）：提升类支出执行率最低，对应提升类任务完成率最低——社区服务及养老托幼设施 79.2%、智慧安防 89.7%
  - 问题成因（资金侧）：竣工结算审计周期平均 92 天，已审计项目 41 个、占已竣工项目 65.1%，审计滞后是结余沉淀的直接原因
- **Data class: scenario**（问题表述所引全部比率、金额与比例关系）

#### Slide 11 - 四、存在问题（二）：改造实施与群众诉求方面

- **Audience move**: 从"认可资金问题"到"确认实施与群众工作方面三个问题同样有出处，且逐条对应第一部分完成率与第三部分满意度维度、诉求分类"
- **Relationships**: 问题三、问题四、问题五为并列（同属实施与群众诉求方面）；每个问题下"问题表现—数据溯源—满意度呼应"为 parent→membership；问题三与 P04 完成率、P08 短板维度为 link；问题四与 P08 最低维度、P09 施工期诉求为 link；问题五与 P09 物业衔接诉求为 link
- **Composition**: 三栏问题卡横向并列，每卡自上而下为问题编号与题名、问题表现、数据溯源（标注出处页）、满意度或任务呼应；卡底一条统一的"来源指向"细线，分别指向第一部分与第三部分
- **Title**: 存在问题（二）：改造实施与群众诉求方面
- **Core message**: 三个问题分别对应完善类与提升类任务滞后、施工期现场管理不足、改造与管护衔接缺位，出处依次为 P04、P08、P09
- **Content**:
  - 判断句：实施与群众工作方面的三个问题，全部能在第一部分完成率与第三部分满意度数据中找到对应项。
  - 问题三：完善类、提升类任务推进不平衡，滞后项集中在群众最关切事项
  - 问题三数据溯源（P04）：加装电梯完成率 80.0%、社区服务及养老托幼设施 79.2%、新增停车泊位 89.4%、智慧安防 89.7%，均低于总体完工率 92.6%
  - 问题三满意度呼应（P08）：加装电梯推进 84.6%、停车与充电设施 82.1%，为七个维度中最低两项；未办结诉求中电梯与停车两类合计 118 条、占 64.1%（P09）
  - 问题四：施工期现场管理不到位，直接影响群众感受
  - 问题四数据溯源（P08、P09）：施工期文明管理（噪声、扬尘、通行）满意度 79.4%，为全维度最低；未办结诉求中施工期噪声扬尘 32 条、占 17.4%
  - 问题四问题表现：部分项目未落实公示告知、错峰施工与扬尘抑制措施；68 个小区配备现场监督员 42 名，覆盖率 61.8%
  - 问题五：改造与后续管护衔接不够，长效机制尚未建立
  - 问题五数据溯源（P09）：未办结诉求中"配套设施及物业衔接"34 条、占 18.5%
  - 问题五问题表现：63 个已完工小区中 45 个落实物业服务、覆盖率 71.4%，其余 18 个仍由社区代管；后续管护资金渠道未明确
- **Data class: scenario**（问题表述所引全部比率、条数与覆盖率）

### Part 6: 五、下一步计划

#### Slide 12 - 五、下一步计划（一）：整改措施与时限安排

- **Audience move**: 从"看清五个问题"到"确认七项措施逐条对应问题、目标值以现状 → 目标表述、时限与责任单位明确，具备可督办性"
- **Relationships**: 七项措施为 order（按问题一至问题五排列）；每项措施与其对应问题为 link（一一对应，问题三对应措施 3、4、5）；每项措施下"措施内容—目标值—完成时限—责任单位"为 membership
- **Composition**: 整版记录表：六列为序号、对应问题、整改措施、目标值（现状 → 目标）、完成时限、责任单位；对应问题列使用问题编号与语义色标记，与 P10、P11 编号一致
- **Title**: 下一步整改措施与时限安排
- **Core message**: 七项措施逐条对应五个问题，全部目标值以"现状 → 目标"同口径表述，时限最迟不超过 2027 年 6 月底
- **Content**:
  - 判断句：五个问题对应七项措施，目标值、时限、责任单位逐条落地。
  - 措施 1（对应问题一）：报请区政府追加 2026 年度区级配套预算，签订管线单位共建共担协议 3 家，居民出资实行"一小区一方案"分摊｜资金到位率 90.0% → 100%（补齐缺口 4280 万元：区级 2140、社会资本 1140、居民 1000）｜2026 年 10 月底前区级到位、12 月底前社会及居民出资到位｜区财政局、区住建局、各街道
  - 措施 2（对应问题二）：建立"竣工一个、结算一个、审计一个"机制，压缩结算审计周期｜平均审计周期 92 天 → 45 天；支出执行率 86.0% → 98.0% 以上，消化结余 5393 万元｜2026 年 12 月底前｜区审计局、区财政局、区住建局
  - 措施 3（对应问题三）：5 个在建小区实行"一小区一策"清单化推进｜小区完工率 92.6% → 100%（剩余 5 个、36 栋、1600 户、13.1 万平方米）｜2026 年 11 月底前｜各街道、区住建局、代建单位
  - 措施 4（对应问题三）：加装电梯攻坚与停车资源挖潜｜电梯 96 部 → 120 部（完成率 80.0% → 100%）；停车泊位 2860 个 → 3200 个（89.4% → 100%）；充电设施 241 处 → 260 处（92.7% → 100%）｜2027 年 6 月底前｜区住建局、区规划资源分局、各街道
  - 措施 5（对应问题三）：补齐提升类设施短板｜社区服务及养老托幼设施 19 处 → 24 处（79.2% → 100%）；智慧安防 61 个 → 68 个（89.7% → 100%）；绿化及公共空间 14.1 万㎡ → 15.6 万㎡（90.4% → 100%）｜2027 年 6 月底前｜区民政局、区住建局、各街道
  - 措施 6（对应问题四）：施工期文明管理"三个一"（一张告示、一名监督员、一个投诉电话），未办结诉求台账销号｜现场监督员覆盖率 61.8% → 100%；诉求办结率 85.7% → 100%；施工期文明管理满意度 79.4% → 90% 以上｜2026 年 12 月底前｜各街道、区住建局、施工单位
  - 措施 7（对应问题五）："改造 + 物业"衔接，明确管护资金渠道并建立年度回访｜已完工小区物业服务覆盖率 71.4% → 100%（45 个 → 63 个）；总体满意度保持 95% 以上｜2026 年 12 月底前｜区住建局、区房管部门、各街道
  - 表下口径行：目标值一律以"现状 → 目标"表述，现状值取自 P03—P09 同一口径数据，不另设统计范围
- **Visualization**: 整改措施与时限记录表（rectification-record-table），子项为七条措施记录、对应问题标记、时限与责任单位列；Native-ready: rectification-record-table=yes
- **Data class: scenario**（全部目标值、时限、责任单位与协议数量）

#### Slide 13 - 五、下一步计划（二）：长效管护机制与提请审议事项

- **Audience move**: 从"认可整改措施"到"明确三项长效机制与三项提请审议事项，准备作出通过决定"
- **Relationships**: 三项长效机制为并列 membership（管护、评价、监督）；三项提请审议事项为 order（须逐项表决）；总体目标五项比率与 P03—P09 现状值为 link（现状 → 目标）
- **Composition**: 上部为三项长效机制横向并列，中部为总体目标口径带（五项比率现状 → 目标），下部为三项提请审议事项编号列出，收尾一行结束语句
- **Closing impact**: 收束要点为"三项指标一条线：小区完工率 92.6%、资金到位率 90.0%、居民满意度 93.8%；至 2027 年 6 月底分别达到 100%、100%、95% 以上"，并以"以上汇报，提请评审组审议"结束；建议以深藏青底、赭金细线的收尾带承载，与封面形成呼应
- **Title**: 长效管护机制与提请审议事项
- **Core message**: 建立"改造—管护—评价"闭环，提请评审组审议三项事项
- **Content**:
  - 判断句：整改之外同步建立长效机制，并提请评审组审议三项事项。
  - 长效机制一（管护）：完工小区竣工即移交物业服务，管护资金由物业服务费、小区公共收益与财政补贴三渠道明确分担
  - 长效机制二（评价）：每季度开展满意度回访，年度公布改造绩效，回访口径与本次调查一致（满意度 =（满意 + 基本满意）÷ 有效问卷 × 100%）
  - 长效机制三（监督）：资金全过程跟踪审计与按小区公示常态化，公示率保持 100%，审计覆盖率由 65.1% 提升至 100%
  - 总体目标（至 2027 年 6 月底，同口径）：小区完工率 92.6% → 100%；资金到位率 90.0% → 100%；支出执行率 86.0% → 98% 以上；诉求办结率 85.7% → 100%；居民总体满意度 93.8% → 95% 以上
  - 提请审议事项一：同意追加区级配套资金 2140 万元并纳入 2026 年度财政预算
  - 提请审议事项二：同意 5 个在建小区竣工时限调整至 2026 年 11 月底
  - 提请审议事项三：支持将管线单位"共建共担"机制纳入市级文件，明确社会与居民出资分担规则
  - 结束语：以上汇报，提请评审组审议。
- **Data class: scenario**（三项目标比率、审议事项金额与时限）

## X. Speaker Notes Requirements

- **Generation**: enabled
- **Filename**: 与 `svg_output/` 下每个 SVG 同名，置于 `notes/`（如 `01_cover.svg` → `notes/01_cover.md`）
- **Content**: 每页讲稿包含四段——本页判断句复述、数据口径说明（分母与保留位数）、与前后页的呼应关系（尤其问题页须点明数据出处页）、面向专家质询的预备答复要点；所有数值只引用页面已出现的同一口径数据，不引入新数字；公文语体，不使用口语化表达
- **Total duration**: 全篇约 22 分钟（封面与纲要 3 分钟、第一部分 4 分钟、第二部分 5 分钟、第三部分 4 分钟、第四部分 3 分钟、第五部分 3 分钟），另留 10—15 分钟质询
- **Notes style**: formal（公文汇报语体，判断句 + 依据 + 口径 + 请审议）
- **Presentation purpose**: 按五项纲目逐项汇报并说明责任，以统一口径数据证明任务完成、资金合规、群众认可，主动暴露问题并回溯来源，最终取得评审组对整改措施与三项提请审议事项的通过决定

<!-- ppt-master-schema: spec-lock/v1 -->
# Execution Lock

## canvas
- viewBox: 0 0 1280 720
- format: PPT 16:9

## communication
- primary_language: zh-CN
- audience: 政府评审组（老旧小区改造专项评审专家、区政府分管领导及住建、财政、审计等部门负责人），逐页核数、关注口径一致性与问题真实性
- objective: 按用户给定五项纲目逐项汇报改造任务完成情况、资金使用情况与居民满意度，用统一口径数据证明任务真实完成、资金合规使用、群众认可，主动暴露五个问题并逐条回溯到第二、第三部分的具体比率，最终使评审组认可整改安排并通过三项提请审议事项
- core_message: 小区完工率 92.6%、资金到位率 90.0%、支出执行率 86.0%、居民满意度 93.8%；4280 万元资金缺口与三个低于 90% 的满意度短板维度是全部五个问题的来源；七项措施把五项比率推至 100%、100%、98% 以上、100%、95% 以上，提请审议三项事项
- consumption_mode: balanced

## mode
- mode: custom
- mode_references: briefing, pyramid
- mode_behavior: 公文化汇报体——每页以一句判断句结论前置统领事实，正文按公文条目化方式完整、均衡、可扫读地铺陈数据、表格与口径说明，不作渲染性论述；页面标题使用"（一）（二）"式公文章节题名，末章集中提出审议请求，形成结论—依据—问题—措施—审议闭环。

## visual_style

- visual_style_references: swiss-minimal, data-journalism
