---

### 6.2 Color, Alpha, and Opacity

Write solid paint as uppercase `#RRGGBB`, `none`, or an exact local `url(#id)`.
Put alpha on the channel that owns it — `fill-opacity`, `stroke-opacity`,
`stop-opacity`, or `flood-opacity` as a unitless `0..1` — and use element
`opacity` only for an `<image>` or one non-group atomic object that fades all
of its channels together. Do not use element `opacity` as an alias for
`rgba()` on a fill-only object, and prefer descendant alpha over group opacity
(§2.2). Alpha multiplies down the tree: color alpha × ancestor group opacity ×
element opacity × channel opacity. Named colors, short/alpha HEX, `rgb()` /
`hsl()`, and percentages remain compatible input that the checker only
recommends normalizing.

---

### 6.3 Gradients and Paint Effects

A gradient is a direct `<linearGradient>` / `<radialGradient>` in `<defs>` with
≥2 explicit-color stops at non-decreasing `0..1` offsets, referenced by exact
`url(#id)`, in `objectBoundingBox` units — no `gradientTransform`,
`spreadMethod`, or CSS gradients. Linear exports as an angle
(`Native-normalized`); radial keeps only its focus point and normalizes the
outer circle to the object (`Approximate`), so place the hotspot with `fx/fy`
inside the object and expect the rim to differ. Text takes gradient fill only;
images take no gradient paint (use §6.5 overlays). A gradient *stroke* needs a
path with both width and height — a perfectly horizontal or vertical gradient
ribbon disappears, so author it as a closed gradient-filled band. Stop colors
are contextual paint: keep them coherent with the deck anchors and page
intent without duplicating a lock row.

```xml
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="flow" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#2563EB"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#10B981" stop-opacity="0.7"/>
  </linearGradient>
</defs>
<path d="M100 200 C260 80 420 320 620 180" fill="none"
      stroke="url(#flow)" stroke-width="12"/>
```

**Native text picture/texture fill**: when the design calls for a photograph,
material, or texture inside editable glyphs, fill the `<text>` (or a
non-positional `<tspan>`) with a registered single-image `<pattern>` marked
`data-pptx-text-image-fill="stretch"` or `"tile"`. It exports as a PowerPoint
run picture fill (`stretch` `Native-normalized`; `tile` needs visual review),
not as a general SVG pattern; the text stays editable. The glyphs are the
only thing showing the image, so the fill must read as one value against the
ground — a near-uniform texture or material, not a scene, gradient, or
anything with its own light and dark regions, which breaks the letterforms
into unreadable patches (a 2026-09-10 cover title was lost this way).

```xml
<defs>
  <pattern id="titleTexture" data-pptx-text-image-fill="stretch"
           patternUnits="objectBoundingBox"
           patternContentUnits="objectBoundingBox" width="1" height="1">
    <image href="../images/cloud-texture.png"
           x="0" y="0" width="1" height="1"
           preserveAspectRatio="none"/>
  </pattern>
</defs>
<text x="96" y="220" fill="url(#titleTexture)" fill-opacity="0.85"
      font-family="Microsoft YaHei" font-size="72" font-weight="700">
  国风之美
</text>
```

Preset patterns are a separate PPT interface in [`native-data-interface.md`](./native-data-interface.md).

---

### 6.4 Shadows, Glow, and Elevation

A filter is native-effect metadata, not a pixel-filter surface: one direct
`<defs><filter>` referenced as a direct `filter="url(#id)"` on a `<rect>`,
`<circle>`, `<polygon>`, `<image>`, `<path>`, `<text>`, or a helper-authored preset group,
built from `feDropShadow` or the blur + flood + composite + merge graph below
with explicit `stdDeviation`, `dx`/`dy`, and `flood-opacity`. A meaningful
offset becomes one outer shadow; zero offset — even `feDropShadow` with
`dx="0" dy="0"` — becomes one glow. Both are `Approximate`: one filter, one
DrawingML effect. Filters on `<tspan>` or ordinary `<g>` and every other
primitive are forbidden; use an existing accent color for glow, since black
reads as diffuse shadow.

```xml
<defs>
  <filter id="softShadow" x="-15%" y="-20%" width="130%" height="150%">
    <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="6" stdDeviation="8"
                  flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.10"/>
  </filter>
  <filter id="expandedShadow" x="-15%" y="-20%" width="130%" height="150%">
    <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="8" result="b"/>
    <feOffset in="b" dx="0" dy="6" result="o"/>
    <feFlood flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.10" result="c"/>
    <feComposite in="c" in2="o" operator="in" result="s"/>
    <feMerge><feMergeNode in="s"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
  </filter>
  <filter id="titleGlow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
    <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="6" result="b"/>
    <feFlood flood-color="#38BDF8" flood-opacity="0.45" result="c"/>
    <feComposite in="c" in2="b" operator="in" result="g"/>
    <feMerge><feMergeNode in="g"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
  </filter>
</defs>
```

34:- **Category charts** — `column`, `bar`, `line`, `area`, `pie`, `doughnut`, `pieOfPie`, `barOfPie`, `radar`: `categories` plus `series[].values`. Column, bar, line, and area values may be `null` for a gap (the workbook cell stays blank, the cache omits the point, `dispBlanksAs` is `gap`; at least one value per series is a number) — a fallback that breaks one line into segments is two series of the same colour with `null` outside their segment. Pie-family charts take exactly one series with per-slice colors; `hole_size` is doughnut-only, integer `10..90`, default `75`; no rotation field. Column/bar may set `series[].point_colors` (camelCase `pointColors` is read-compatible; length = values; every entry a colour — a `null` gap is line-only). Bar categories run top-down in payload order — the exporter reverses the category axis and moves the value-axis crossing so the value axis keeps its declared position; `axes.category.reverse: false` restores PowerPoint's bottom-up order (column charts stay left-to-right unless `reverse: true`). Bar/column spacing: root `gap_width` (`0..500`, the empty slot share as a percentage of one bar; PowerPoint default `150`; one category slot is the plot height (or width) divided by the category count and `bar = slot / (1 + gap_width / 100)`, so a chosen bar size converts back to `gap_width = (slot / bar - 1) × 100`) and clustered `overlap` (`-100..100`, the share of one bar the next series covers, negative for a gap); SVG-first export reads both from the fallback bars inside `plot_area` when the payload omits them, JSON-first uses the defaults.
35:- **Line markers** — `line_style: "lineMarker"` draws a circle at every point in the series colour; `marker_size` (root or per series, SVG px diameter, `2..72` pt after `×0.75`) sizes it. `line_style` itself is a chart-root option — `series[].line_style` is rejected; inside a `combo` it sits on the plot or on a typed series. `series[].point_colors` on a line series marks single points: a colour draws that point's marker in that colour, `null` leaves it bare (with `line_style: "line"` only the coloured points carry markers), so an emphasised endpoint is `[null, …, "#C8102E"]`. Area series draw no markers; a line with markers over a fill is a `combo`. `data_labels` (column, bar, line, and area plots only, combo plots of those types included; pie-family, radar, scatter/bubble, stock, and ChartEx charts reject it — show their values through companion `notes`) is `true` or an object with `show_value`, `position`, `number_format`, `font_size`, `font_family`, `bold`, `color`, per-point `colors`, and `points` (zero-based `idx` plus optional overrides — with an explicit `show_*` flag every point keeps its label and `delete: true` hides one; without one only the listed points are labeled); positions: clustered column/bar `outside_end` / `inside_end` / `inside_base` / `center`, stacked `inside_end` / `inside_base` / `center`, line `above` / `center` / `best_fit`, area none; `series[].data_labels` takes the same object for one series, so two lines can label different points. Set `data_labels.number_format` to match the fallback (the parity gate reads `0`, `0.0`, `0.00`, `#,##0`, `#,##0.0`, their `%` forms — which scale the value by 100 — and a quoted literal prefix/suffix such as `"$"#,##0` or `0.0"%"`; other codes match only the literal value)'s rendered value labels. Rendered forms follow the en-US pattern (`.` decimal, `,` thousands); a deck written with locale separators (`1.234,5`) keeps such numbers out of the chart marker — integer ticks, no `data_labels`, the formatted figures in surrounding text or table cells.
45:SVG-first metadata matches the fallback chrome; JSON-first owns it. Metadata sizes use SVG px (`1px = 0.75pt`); `style.font_family` and `title_font_size`, `subtitle_font_size`, `axis_font_size`, `axis_title_font_size`, `legend_font_size`, `note_font_size` are required only when native must preserve typography an SVG-first fallback cannot supply unambiguously (JSON-first never infers from its preview). A string or unbounded-object `title` becomes native `c:title` (`subtitle` line two); a title object with complete `x`, `y`, `width`, `height` becomes a companion text box (partial bounds or `subtitle` fail); `name` names the object; `title`, `subtitle`, and axis-title objects accept `text`, `font_size`, `font_family`, `color`; the checker rejects SVG-first title/axis text absent from the fallback. Axis titles are explicit via `axis_titles` (`category`, `value`, `x`, `y`, `secondary_value`) or the root aliases `category_axis_title`, `value_axis_title`, `x_axis_title`, `y_axis_title`, `secondary_value_axis_title`; `show_value_axis_labels: false` hides numeric tick labels (e.g. a radar without radial coordinates); native legends are opt-in via `show_legend: true` and `legend_position` (`bottom` default; `top` / `left` / `right`). SVG-first parity reads the fallback literally — `style.text_color` is the fill carried by most visible characters across the marker's text (so a lighter axis-label colour on fewer characters than the category and data labels is not the dominant), `style.axis_color` is the dominant stroke among elements whose id or class names `axis`, `style.grid_color` the dominant stroke among those naming `grid` / `gridline`, and a role with no labeled stroke falls back to the marker's dominant stroke (axis and grid lines in different colors need those labels or one steals the other's dominant); bar/column fills that are not a series or point colour, line-chart circles with no `lineMarker` / `point_colors` (or in a colour neither carries), translucent area fills without `fill_opacity`, a stroked line or markers over a single-type area, and a bar/column fallback whose first and last category labels contradict the resolved `axes.category.reverse` are each reported; numbers match in written form (`286.20` ≠ `286.2`; a payload `73.0` is stored as `73` and renders as `73` under General, so a fallback that shows `73.0` needs `number_format: "0.0"`; a `number_format` on `data_labels` or an axis makes its rendered form, such as `28.0` for `0.0`, an accepted variant), and marker text that is not a category, data label, axis label, or legend entry needs a companion entry. Companion text (`caption`, `source`, `note`, `notes`, `footnote`, `footnotes`) exports as editable text boxes — strings or objects with `text`, `x`, `y`, `width`, `height` (slide coordinates), `font_size`, `color`, `align`, `bold`; use it for captions, sources, center labels, and annotations, and `data_labels` for point values. On an SVG-first marker a companion whose text appears exactly once in the fallback is placed from that `<text>`: the box is bottom-anchored with its bottom edge a quarter em under that baseline (so the glyph bottom lands where the SVG drew it whatever ascent the viewer's font has), `text-anchor` decides which edge `x` names and the paragraph alignment, and the payload keeps only `width` — so a `y` copied from the SVG baseline does not push the box onto the plot. JSON-first and unmatched companions use the payload box. `style.colors` sets series colors (treemap/sunburst tile palette in order); the exporter writes explicit chart-area fill, plot-area fill, axis, gridline, and label colors (SVG-first infers them from the largest panel `<rect>`, text, and strokes; JSON-first from JSON or stable defaults), overridable under `style` with `chart_area_fill`, `plot_area_fill`, `text_color`, `axis_color`, `grid_color` (`"none"` for transparent); generated payloads use uppercase `#RRGGBB`, with `#RGB`, `rgb()`, and CSS names normalized. Negative bars keep the series fill. The final checker reports every SVG-first parity finding as a warning tagged `(blocks --native-charts-and-tables export)`; that export refuses the same findings as errors, so clear them before exporting the native variant.

content.text:
Default first free port from `6060` (`--port N` binds strictly); read the URL from output or `<project_path>/live_preview/lock.json` and report it — or the launch failure, or that the user or run instructions forbade starting it — before the first SVG. It is a side process: never wait for it or for user confirmation, and keep it running until the user clicks **Exit preview** or asks in chat. Do not read or apply submitted annotations during generation; that window opens after Step 7 ([`live-preview.md`](stages/live-preview.md), which also describes staged direct edits).

**Cadence (Mandatory)**: P01–P05 → early gate (a planned roster of six or fewer pages skips it) → remaining pages → final gate, in one context. Every checker invocation follows one of two events: a gate point whose covered pages all exist, or the end of one consolidated repair pass. A run with neither predecessor is a pacing violation; validating an authoring pattern early is not a reason, because the same issues surface at the gate and are fixed in the same pass. Reload under Context validity above after context invalidation.

**Visual Construction Phase**: generate pages sequentially into `<project_path>/svg_output/`. Each SVG carries the slide's complete visible design (a JSON-first Chart/Table is the sole exception: inline JSON authoritative, visible subtree an approximate preview). Native shapes follow [`native-shape-authoring.md`](../references/native-shape-authoring.md), loaded at the first contour beyond basic primitives while the preset vocabulary is read before page one: independent atoms first, Merge Shapes only when contour semantics require it, freeform last.

| Structure | Page authoring |
|---|---|
| `mirror` / `layout` | Start from the complete `page_layouts` SVG and preserve inherited visuals, root identity, atoms, and slots. Strict keeps the contract; `layout` may reflow carrier text inside unchanged slot bounds; adaptive uses a Strategist-declared Layout. A required atom or slot change returns upstream; Executor never edits `spec_lock.md`. |
| `style`, free design, brand-only | Flat per `executor-base.md` and [`semantic-svg.md`](../references/semantic-svg.md). |

**Motion endpoints**: when custom motion is active — an explicit user motion instruction, an enabled Custom Animations outcome in §I, or an existing `animations.json` — author the visible endpoint states now under [`executor-base.md`](../references/executor-base.md) §1; a §IX suggestion alone activates nothing.

**Early gate (Mandatory)** — after the fifth SVG, before page 6; a planned roster of six or fewer pages skips this gate and goes straight to the final gate:

```bash
python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/svg_quality_checker.py <project_path> \
  --canonical-authoring --stage early --json
```

`--json` writes the report file (`validation/svg_quality_early_report.json`); stdout stays the human-readable summary and is never parsed as JSON. The stage checks every authored page so far under the partial-roster rules. Repair under the consolidated-pass discipline in [`executor-base.md`](../references/executor-base.md) §3; a still-failing verification is the next batch. If terminal output is truncated, extract only `categories.blocking.issues` (and `categories.introduced.issues` when needed) from `validation/svg_quality_early_report.json`. The gate validates the method, not just the pages — emit one line before editing (in the conversation, not to a file):

```
gate-signal: method=<rule resolved, or none> | page-local=<count> | not-exercised=<list>
```

| Signal | Reading |
|---|---|
| Two or more issues share a category and direction — on one page or across pages — or one issue sits in a writing form the deck repeats on every page (a paragraph construction, a header line, a card frame), which a long deck copies before the final gate | Method-level bias — resolve to the authoritative rule before P06 (for text extents: correct the per-role calibration table — rerun `python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/text_measure.py calibrate <project_path> --outline` or add the missing `--role` — then every later page estimates by that arithmetic and measures nothing); a correction fitted to the observed offset patches only this sample |
| One isolated issue tied to a single page's structure | Page-local — fix and continue |
| A recurring element (furniture, caption format, section numbering, accent discipline) drifts between its occurrences or is still unsettled | It will be copied to every later page — settle its semantics now |

`not-exercised` names what P01–P05 could not test (five pages usually exercise multi-line text, columns, and captions; charts, tables, or other data objects may still be pending); carry each resolved rule forward as arithmetic. Every later page runs without checker calls; a listed item first exercised later is held to the carried-forward rule and caught by the final gate.

**Quality Check Gate (Mandatory)** — only after every planned SVG exists, before annotations and speaker notes:

```bash
python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/svg_quality_checker.py <project_path> \
  --canonical-authoring --stage final --json
```

- Before the gate, every §IX `Native-ready` `<object-key>=yes` has its draw-time marker group and JSON child; `=no` and incidental microvisuals stay ordinary SVG (a legacy bare `yes|no` is readable only when the page has exactly one eligible object). JSON-first Chart/Table validates inline schema/bounds; SVG-first markers need a current `data-pptx-fallback-sha256`, stamped after synchronization — missing or stale baselines block canonical/native export, not fallback export.
- `--json` writes `validation/svg_quality_report.json`, the report the exporter fingerprints against `svg_output/`; stdout stays the human-readable summary and is never parsed as JSON. Without `--json` the export is refused.
- One run against `svg_output/` reports every page; repair under the consolidated-pass discipline in [`executor-base.md`](../references/executor-base.md) §3. If output is truncated, extract only `categories.blocking.issues` (and `categories.introduced.issues` when needed) from that run's `validation/svg_quality_report.json`, where `inherited` and `source-import` are provenance and `introduced` holds changed/new warnings.
- Structured-template warnings (empty/framing-only Layout, bare Master, duplicate layout keys) guide optional cleanup only; a condition that must be corrected before release is an `error`.
- **Hard rule — token-safe report handling**: on success use the exit status and terminal summary; never `cat` the complete JSON into context. Read it only for failure investigation, an explicit audit, or a field absent from stdout.

**Mandatory — final carrier-receipt review**: run the review in [`executor-base.md`](../references/executor-base.md) §3 Checkpoints against the retained §IX page jobs, resource roles, and geometry signatures; a repair reruns the final checker once.

**Logic Construction Phase (conditional)**: when the effective Speaker Notes outcome in §I is enabled, load [`executor-notes.md`](../references/executor-notes.md): validate a frozen `notes/total.md` against every information-bearing final SVG group (repair the page or the plan, never the script), or otherwise ground each page's narration in its final SVG and write `notes/total.md`. When disabled, load nothing and create no notes.

**✅ Internal checkpoint** — preview launched in time, early gate after P05 (skipped on a roster of six or fewer pages), uninterrupted remaining pages, consolidated repair, exact §IX coverage, one-frame prose, final checker 0 errors, `notes/total.md` only when enabled. Do not print. Then run the applicable conditional gates and proceed to Step 7.

> **Chart pages?** Run [`verify-charts`](stages/verify-charts.md) before Step 7 to calibrate coordinates; skip without chart pages.
>
> **Visual self-check (opt-in)?** Run [`visual-review`](stages/visual-review.md) before Step 7 only when the user explicitly asked for a per-page visual re-pass ("跑一下视觉自检 / 视觉回看", "visual review", "check pages visually"); never by default, on inferred model capability, or on deck size.
>
> **Motion execution (conditional)?** An existing `animations.json` always runs [`customize-animations`](stages/customize-animations.md) before export. Without a sidecar, run it only for an explicit per-slide/per-object request or an enabled Custom Animations outcome in §I (§IX suggestions inform it, never trigger it); a deck-wide request loads [`animations.md`](../references/animations.md) and resolves Step 7.3 flags instead; otherwise keep `fade` / `none` and load nothing. Executor owns effects, options, order, timing, and simplification to `none`; never add motion for coverage. Sound is never a Strategist resource: no id or path in `design_spec.md` / `spec_lock.md`, and any cue is selected only after the motion solution is final under `animations.md` §2.2.

---

### Step 7: Post-processing & Export

🚧 **GATE**: Step 6 complete — every final page in `svg_output/`, all conditional gates passed, final report 0 errors, and `notes/total.md` covering every page when Speaker Notes is enabled.

🚧 **Image readiness GATE**: when any required row is `Needs-Manual`, every expected file and slice output must exist under `images/` before the first Step 7 command. If any is absent, pause and list the exact filenames; never run `finalize_svg.py` or `svg_to_pptx.py`, never ship the dashed placeholder. When the files arrive, rerun `analyze_images.py`, replace each placeholder, reconcile every `no-crop` container to the measured native ratio, and rerun the final checker (which then closes each terminal §VIII row through `spec_lock.md images`, the exact file, and a real `<image href>`, and validates Sourced provenance, visible credits, and per-placement pixel scale under `meet` / `slice` / `none`).

**Hard rule — strict serial commands**: one command at a time, each in its own invocation; enter the next sub-step only after the current one exits successfully and its success criterion holds. On failure, repair the owning source artifact and resume from the failed sub-step ([`failure-recovery.md`](./governance/failure-recovery.md)); never restart planning unless its source changed.

#### Step 7.1 — Split Speaker Notes (only when enabled)

```bash
python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/total_md_split.py <project_path>
```

**Success criterion**: per-slide Markdown files under `notes/` cover every published slide. When disabled, skip to 7.2.

#### Step 7.2 — Build the Self-Contained SVG Preview

```bash
python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/finalize_svg.py <project_path>
```

**Success criterion**: `svg_final/` holds one self-contained preview per slide. Its absence never blocks 7.3.

#### Step 7.3 — Export the Native PPTX

| Effective decision | Command |
|---|---|
| Speaker Notes `enabled` | `python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/svg_to_pptx.py <project_path>` |
| Speaker Notes `disabled` | `python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/svg_to_pptx.py <project_path> --no-notes` |

| Decision | Flag |
|---|---|
| Explicit editable Chart/Table delivery decision, or a structured `chart` / `table` placeholder slot | Append `--native-charts-and-tables` (markers, templates, semantic tables, and imported charts never activate it; formulas are always native) |
| Final checker reports oversized images | Append `--image-sizing display` |
| Preserved or produced `animations.json` | Keep the base command; the exporter reads the sidecar |
| Deck-wide motion setting | Append the resolved [`animations.md`](../references/animations.md) flags |
| Explicit Custom Animations disable | Keep the sidecar and append `-a none` |
| Explicit all-motion disable | `--no-animations` |
| Final Stage-2 `false` | Neither flag |
| Conversion trace | Do not add `--conversion-trace` to every base export; an explicit `--conversion-trace <path>` writes to that destination instead of the default |

# ---- generic: merge consecutive sibling <text> runs that share x and are flagged ----
def merge_runs(name, pairs):
    p = pathlib.Path(name); s = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    for lines in pairs:
        old = "\n".join(lines)
        assert old in s, f"{name}: {lines[0][:50]}"
        first = lines[0]
        m = re.match(r'(\s*)<text (x="[\d.]+" y="[\d.+"].*?)>(.*)</text>$', first)
        indent, attrs, txt = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
        prev_y = float(re.search(r'y="([\d.]+)"', attrs).group(1))
        out = f'{indent}<text {attrs}>{txt}'
        for ln in lines[1:]:
            mm = re.match(r'\s*<text x="([\d.]+)" y="([\d.]+)"[^>]*>(.*)</text>$', ln)
            dy = round(float(mm.group(2)) - prev_y, 3)
            dy = int(dy) if dy == int(dy) else dy
            out += f'<tspan x="{mm.group(1)}" dy="{dy}">{mm.group(3)}</tspan>'
            prev_y = float(mm.group(2))
        out += '</text>'
        s = s.replace(old, out)
    p.write_text(s, encoding='utf-8'); print(name, 'runs merged')

---
description: Conditional quality-gate stage for data-chart geometry and encoding verification.
---

# Verify Charts Stage

> Conditional Generate-PPTX quality stage. Run after a deck containing data charts has finished SVG generation and before post-processing/export; it catches coordinate and encoding errors introduced while mapping source values into SVG marks. Default runs it context-independently from `design_spec.md` plus the SVGs; the lockless Quick branch runs in the same active session from the page decisions just authored — if that context is lost, restart Quick rather than inventing a page plan from finished files.

## When to Run

- The deck contains at least one chart where source values determine SVG geometry or encoding (bar lengths, point positions, arc angles, polygon vertices, connector endpoints, bubble centers/radii, flow widths, cell colors, word sizes).
- SVGs exist in `<project_path>/svg_output/` and `finalize_svg.py` / `svg_to_pptx.py` have not run. Default enters from its quality-gate order; Quick runs it before its one lockless final checker.

The calculator has direct models for bars, lines/scatter, pie/donut, radar, and grids. Composite charts are not out of scope: geometry that reduces to repeated direct calculations is `decomposable-calc`; data-driven geometry with no layout model is `manual-verify`, never silently skipped.

---

## Step 1: Build the chart-object list from the active profile authority

| Active profile | Object-list authority |
|---|---|
| Default Generate | `design_spec.md §IX` — every semantic object key whose `Visualization` entry declares value-driven SVG geometry; §VII only resolves a selected catalog reference, and one real §VII data-chart row may supply one legacy object for a page whose §IX predates object keys |
| Quick Generate | The still-active semantic object keys and page decisions, cross-checked one-for-one against every `chart-plot-area` marker found by one search of `svg_output/`; add a missing scoped marker, investigate an unexpected one, keep the list in active context only |

Incidental microvisuals not promoted by the profile authority are not inferred into the list: Default repairs §IX first; Quick decides promotion in active context and updates the marker before verification. Never guess from SVG content when §IX declares no data-driven object.

| Mode | `charts_index.json` keys | Notes |
|------|--------------------------|-------|
| `direct-calc` | `column_chart`, `horizontal_bar_chart`, `histogram_chart` | `calc bar`; `--horizontal` for horizontal bars; histogram bins are contiguous bars on the numeric x-axis |
| `direct-calc` | `line_chart`, `area_chart`, `scatter_chart` | `calc line`; area uses the line output as the top boundary, then closes to `y_max` |
| `direct-calc` | `pie_chart`, `donut_chart` | `calc pie`; donut passes `--inner-radius` |
| `direct-calc` | `radar_chart` | `calc radar` (separate subcommand) |
| `decomposable-calc` | `stacked_bar_chart`, `stacked_area_chart`, `grouped_bar_chart`, `dumbbell_chart`, `pareto_chart`, `dual_axis_line_chart`, `bullet_chart`, `butterfly_chart`, `waterfall_chart`, `box_plot_chart`, `gantt_chart`, `bar_of_pie_chart`, `pie_of_pie_chart`, `stock_chart` | Repeated direct calculations per the [verification recipes](../../scripts/docs/svg-pipeline.md#verification-recipes) |
| `partial-calc` | `bubble_chart`, `matrix_2x2` | `calc line` for x/y-driven `cx/cy`; radius only with an explicit size scale |
| `formula-verify` | `progress_bar_chart`, `gauge_chart`, `funnel_chart`, `sunburst_chart` | Quote the formula and resulting length/angle/width in the receipt |
| `manual-verify` | `sankey_chart`, `heatmap_chart`, `treemap_chart`, `word_cloud` | Data-driven, but no layout model; inspect and report |

**Family boundary**: this table covers every canonical `charts_index.json` key exactly once. Qualitative shape composition and Table references never enter the receipt merely because they contain shapes or numbers; named quadrants are composed through [`executor-structure.md`](../../references/executor-structure.md), and `chart/matrix_2x2` is reserved for plotted x/y data. Every embedded data chart is its own keyed §IX object.

```

If the list is empty, output `verify-charts: active profile declares no data-driven chart objects, nothing to verify` and stop.

---

## Step 2: Per object — read its SVG scope, calculate, compare, update

1. Read `<project_path>/svg_output/<page>.svg`; locate `<g id="<object-key>">` and its one plot-area marker (`chart-plot-area: object=<object-key> | …` inside `<g id="<object-key>-chartArea">`). A legacy unscoped marker with `id="chartArea"` is accepted only when the page has exactly one verified chart; a multi-chart page never mixes scoped and unscoped markers. Derive and add a missing scoped marker from the axes or center/radius before continuing.
2. Read only that object's data series and label/value elements.
3. **Read axis tick labels for every axis-based chart** — X-axis labels for horizontal bars, Y-axis labels for vertical bars and line-like charts. The first and last tick values give the axis range; pass it as attached `--value-range=min,max` / `--y-range=…` / `--x-range=…` (the attached form also protects a negative minimum). Radar takes `--max-value` from the outermost ring. With no tick labels, omit the range, let the calculator auto-normalize, and flag the receipt `scale=auto (no ticks)`; a deliberately hidden value axis takes its range from the native payload's axis minimum / maximum instead.
4. **Local vs absolute**: content inside `<g transform="translate(cx, cy)">` has relative coordinates; the calculator outputs absolute ones. Add the translate to the SVG values or subtract it from the calculator output — one direction, consistently.
5. Run the matching command (see the [calculator documentation](../../scripts/docs/svg-pipeline.md#svg_position_calculatorpy) and recipes for decomposable, partial, formula, and manual modes):

   ```bash
   python3 skills/ppt-master/scripts/svg_position_calculator.py calc bar --data "L1:V1,L2:V2" --area "x_min,y_min,x_max,y_max" --bar-width 120 --value-range=0,axis_max   # a Native-ready bar/column passes --gap-width <payload gap_width, default 150> instead of --bar-width so the category axis follows the PowerPoint slot model the parity gate checks
   python3 skills/ppt-master/scripts/svg_position_calculator.py calc line --data "x1:y1,x2:y2" --area "x_min,y_min,x_max,y_max" --y-range=0,max   # a Native-ready category line/area adds --slot-midpoints: PowerPoint centres each point in its category slot (payload `cross_between: "between"`); the edge-to-edge default is the scatter / numeric-axis model and a `mid_category` payload
   python3 skills/ppt-master/scripts/svg_position_calculator.py calc pie --data "S1:V1,S2:V2" --center "cx,cy" --radius 200 [--inner-radius 120] --start-angle -90
   python3 skills/ppt-master/scripts/svg_position_calculator.py calc radar --data "D1:V1,D2:V2,D3:V3" --center "cx,cy" --radius 200 --max-value 100
   ```

6. **Scale-aware comparison**: before declaring a mismatch, confirm every invocation used the axis range, plot area, center/radius, start angle, or size scale the SVG visually declares — for `calc bar` the header must show `Value scale: axis ticks (...)` when the SVG has ticks; `auto (max*1.1)` means go back to step 3. Never update the SVG with mismatched-scale output. When the scale matches and coordinates genuinely differ, update by hand — no regex or bulk replacement. On a signed bar chart the calculator starts every bar at the axis minimum, so compare `x_min + width` against the drawn far edge from the zero baseline rather than its `X`.

After updating any page, follow the profile's checker order. Default reruns `svg_quality_checker.py <project_path> --canonical-authoring --stage final --json`, which writes the current `final` report Step 7.3 requires. Quick completes every chart comparison/repair first, then returns to `quick-generate.md` §4 for its one lockless final checker — no checker call between chart pages.

---

## Step 3: Per-object receipt

One line per Step 1 object, including its semantic key; receipt count MUST equal the list length — that is the gate-closing evidence. Quick does not persist these lines.

```
verify-charts: 03_market_share.svg | object=market-share | type=bar | mode=direct-calc | scale=0-100 (from ticks) | calc=ran | svg=updated
verify-charts: 11_share_split.svg | object=share-split | type=pie | mode=direct-calc | scale=N/A | calc=ran | svg=updated | marker=added
verify-charts: 14_revenue_mix.svg | object=revenue-mix | type=stacked-bar | mode=decomposable-calc | scale=0-200 (from ticks) | calc=ran×3 | svg=updated
verify-charts: 18_market_bubbles.svg | object=market-bubbles | type=bubble | mode=partial-calc | xy=ran | radius=manual (scale missing) | svg=unchanged
verify-charts: 23_quarterly_progress.svg | object=quarterly-progress | type=progress | mode=formula-verify | formula=68/100×800=544px | svg=unchanged
verify-charts: 19_flow.svg | object=flow | type=sankey | mode=manual-verify | link widths consistent with values | svg=unchanged
```

---

## After verification

Default continues with [`generate-pptx`](../generate-pptx.md) Step 7; Quick returns to [`quick-generate`](../profiles/quick-generate.md) §4 for its final checker and direct export.

content.text:
### Part 2: 一、改造任务完成情况

#### Slide 03 - 一、改造任务完成情况（一）：总体完成情况

- **Audience move**: 从"需要确认改造任务是否真的完成"到"认可四项总量指标同口径完成九成以上、总体判定为基本达标，并留下 5 个在建小区的追问点"
- **Relationships**: 计划量与完成量为 contrast（同一计量单位下的目标—实绩对照）；四项完成率互为 membership（同属总量完成率族，共用同一口径）；5 个在建小区与 63 个已竣工小区为 contrast
- **Composition**: 上部页标题与判断句；中部四条有界进度轨纵向排列（计划数、完成数、完成率、判定状态同行显示）；右侧窄栏为计划总盘子与口径说明
- **Title**: 改造任务总体完成情况
- **Core message**: 计划改造 68 个小区，已竣工验收 63 个，小区完工率 92.6%，四项总量指标按同一口径均为九成以上
- **Content**:
  - 判断句：三年改造任务总体完成九成以上，按统一判定阈值属"基本达标"，尚有 5 个小区在建。
  - 计划总盘子（2023—2025 年，2000 年底前建成老旧小区）：68 个小区、512 栋、2.14 万户、186.5 万平方米
  - 四项总量完成率（口径：完成数 ÷ 计划数 × 100%）：小区 63 个，完工率 92.6%，基本达标；楼栋 476 栋，完成率 93.0%，基本达标；居民户 1.98 万户，完成率 92.5%，基本达标；建筑面积 173.4 万平方米，完成率 93.0%，基本达标
  - 在建情况：在建 5 个小区、36 栋、1600 户、13.1 万平方米，占计划小区数 7.4%
  - 口径说明：完工率指已通过竣工验收的小区数占计划改造小区数的比例；"在建"指已开工未竣工；比率保留一位小数，全篇一致
- **Visualization**: 四项总量完成率进度轨（progress-tracks），子项为计划数、完成数、完成率数值与状态色标记；Native-ready: progress-tracks=no
- **Data class: scenario**（全部计划量、完成量与比率）

#### Slide 04 - 一、改造任务完成情况（二）：分项任务完成明细

- **Audience move**: 从"只知道总体完成率"到"看清九项分项任务中三项滞后、集中在完善类与提升类，为第四部分问题埋下依据"
- **Relationships**: 基础设施类、完善类、提升类为 parent，九项分项任务为 membership；各项完成率与统一判定阈值（95% / 90%）为 contrast；滞后三项（电梯、服务设施、停车泊位）互为并列，构成后续问题三的来源
- **Composition**: 整版表格：类别列合并显示三类，右侧六列为改造内容、单位、计划量、完成量、完成率、进度状态；表下为判定阈值口径行
- **Title**: 分项改造任务完成明细
- **Core message**: 九项分项任务中达标 1 项、基本达标 4 项、滞后 4 项，滞后项全部落在群众最关切的完善类与提升类
- **Content**:
  - 判断句：基础设施类总体完成，完善类与提升类三项任务完成率低于 90%，是总体完工率未能达标的主因。
  - 基础设施类：水电气路及雨污分流，个小区，计划 68，完成 63，92.6%，基本达标；光纤及 5G 覆盖，个小区，计划 68，完成 66，97.1%，达标
  - 完善类：加装电梯，部，计划 120，完成 96，80.0%，滞后；新增停车泊位，个，计划 3200，完成 2860，89.4%，滞后；电动自行车充电设施，处，计划 260，完成 241，92.7%，基本达标；无障碍及适老化改造，处，计划 180，完成 163，90.6%，基本达标
  - 提升类：社区服务及养老托幼设施，处，计划 24，完成 19，79.2%，滞后；智慧安防（视频监控、门禁），个小区，计划 68，完成 61，89.7%，滞后；绿化及公共空间，万平方米，计划 15.6，完成 14.1，90.4%，基本达标
  - 判定口径：≥95% 达标、90%（含）—95% 基本达标、<90% 滞后，与 P02 纲要及 P08 满意度维度使用同一阈值
  - 汇总行：九项分项任务，达标 1 项、基本达标 4 项、滞后 4 项
- **Visualization**: 分项任务完成明细表（subtask-metric-table），子项为类别分组行、九项任务行、汇总行与状态色标；Native-ready: subtask-metric-table=yes
- **Data class: scenario**（全部计划量、完成量、完成率与判定结果）

### Part 3: 二、资金使用情况

#### Slide 05 - 二、资金使用情况（一）：资金到位与支出执行总体情况

- **Audience move**: 从"关心钱有没有到位、有没有花出去"到"掌握 42800 万元计划投资的到位、支出、结余三段流转与三项比率，注意到 5393 万元结余尚未形成实物工作量"
- **Relationships**: 计划总投资、到位缺口、实际到位、已支出、账面积余为 order（资金流转顺序，正负贡献串联）；到位率、支出执行率、结余率为同族 membership（分母各不相同，须并列说明）；已支出与账面积余为 contrast
- **Composition**: 上部页标题与判断句；中部左侧为瀑布式资金流转几何（五段，正负以语义色区分），右侧竖排四个 KPI（计划总投资、到位率、支出执行率、结余率）；下部为三项比率的分母口径对照行
- **Title**: 资金到位与支出执行总体情况
- **Core message**: 计划总投资 42800 万元，实际到位 38520 万元、到位率 90.0%；已支出 33127 万元、支出执行率 86.0%；账面积余 5393 万元、结余率 14.0%
- **Content**:
  - 判断句：资金到位九成、支出执行八成六，尚有 5393 万元结余资金未形成实物工作量。
  - 计划总投资 42800 万元（4.28 亿元）；实际到位 38520 万元，到位缺口 4280 万元，资金到位率 90.0%
  - 已支出（已拨付）33127 万元，支出执行率 86.0%；账面积余 5393 万元，结余率 14.0%
  - 户均投入：按已到位资金与已完成户数计算，户均 1.9 万元（38520 万元 ÷ 1.98 万户）
  - 比率口径对照（全篇一致）：资金到位率 = 实际到位 ÷ 计划总投资 × 100% = 90.0%；支出执行率 = 已支出 ÷ 实际到位 × 100% = 86.0%；结余率 = 账面积余 ÷ 实际到位 × 100% = 14.0%
  - 金额单位统一为万元，比率保留一位小数
- **Visualization**: 资金流转瀑布（fund-flow-waterfall），子项为五段金额标注、正负贡献方向与差额连线；Native-ready: fund-flow-waterfall=yes
- **Data class: scenario**（全部金额、比率与户均投入）

#### Slide 06 - 二、资金使用情况（二）：资金来源与支出构成明细

- **Audience move**: 从"知道总体到位率 90.0%"到"看清 4280 万元缺口全部来自区级配套、社会资本与居民出资三个渠道，以及提升类支出执行率 75.9% 最低"
- **Relationships**: 资金来源（六渠道）与资金支出（四分项）为并列 parent，各自渠道/分项为 membership，均含小计与合计；三级财政补助（100.0%）与区级配套（81.8%）、社会资本（73.0%）、居民出资（65.8%）为 contrast；提升类支出执行率（75.9%）与提升类任务完成率（79.2%、89.7%、90.4%）为跨页 link
- **Composition**: 整版分层表格：上半组"资金来源"六行加小计，下半组"资金支出"四行加小计，右侧窄栏为资金监管三条与审计、公示比率
- **Title**: 资金来源与支出构成明细
- **Core message**: 三级财政补助资金 100.0% 到位，区级配套 81.8%、社会资本 73.0%、居民出资 65.8%，构成 4280 万元缺口的全部来源；支出侧提升类执行率 75.9% 为四类最低
- **Content**:
  - 判断句：资金缺口全部产生于区级配套与社会、居民出资三个渠道，支出侧提升类执行最慢。
  - 资金来源（计划数 / 到位数 / 到位率 / 缺口数，单位万元）：中央补助资金 7704 / 7704 / 100.0% / 0；省级补助资金 4622 / 4622 / 100.0% / 0；市级财政资金 11556 / 11556 / 100.0% / 0；区级财政配套 11770 / 9630 / 81.8% / 2140；管线单位及社会资本 4222 / 3082 / 73.0% / 1140；居民出资 2926 / 1926 / 65.8% / 1000；来源合计 42800 / 38520 / 90.0% / 4280
  - 资金支出（资金安排数 / 已支出数 / 支出执行率 / 结余数，单位万元）：基础设施类 18490 / 16564 / 89.6% / 1926；完善类（含加装电梯）11556 / 9938 / 86.0% / 1618；提升类 6548 / 4969 / 75.9% / 1579；前期及管理费 1926 / 1656 / 86.0% / 270；支出合计 38520 / 33127 / 86.0% / 5393
  - 表内口径：来源组"执行"为实际到位、比率为到位率（分母为计划数）；支出组"执行"为已支出、比率为支出执行率（分母为该类资金安排数，安排数合计等于已到位资金 38520 万元）
  - 资金监管三条：专户核算、专款专用（68 个小区全部纳入专户，覆盖率 100%）；全过程跟踪审计（已完成审计 41 个项目，占已竣工项目 65.1%）；资金使用情况按小区公示（68 个，公示率 100%）
  - 结余构成：5393 万元中 3236 万元因竣工结算审计未完成暂不能拨付，占结余总额 60.0%
- **Visualization**: 资金来源与支出分层明细表（fund-hierarchy-table），子项为两组分层行、小计与合计行、到位率/执行率状态色标；Native-ready: fund-hierarchy-table=yes
- **Data class: scenario**（全部金额、比率、审计与公示数据）

### Part 4: 三、居民满意度

#### Slide 07 - 三、居民满意度（一）：调查组织与总体结果

- **Audience move**: 从"怀疑满意度是否可信"到"确认第三方调查的样本、方式、口径可核，总体满意度 93.8% 成立"

=== §IX 判断句 ===
45:- **Mode Behavior**: 公文化汇报体。每页以一句判断句（结论前置，源自 pyramid）统领本页事实，随后按公文条目化方式完整、均衡、可扫读地铺陈数据、表格与口径说明（源自 briefing），不作渲染性论述、不设悬念；页面标题一律使用"（一）（二）"式公文章节题名；末章集中提出审议请求与目标口径，形成"结论—依据—问题—措施—审议"的闭环。
48:- **Visual Style Behavior**: 严格左对齐栅格与 1px 细分隔线，无阴影、无发光、无圆角堆叠（圆角 2px）、无装饰性图形与插画。页眉为"章节编号 + 章名 + 页码"的公文式页眉带（赭金编号、深藏青章名、下缘 1px 分隔线），页脚为"数据来源 + 统计口径 + 数据截至日"的来源行（源自 data-journalism 的 source line 传统）。数据一律以原生表格与条形/瀑布几何呈现，白底为主、浅灰面板为辅，语义色仅用于状态判定（达标/基本达标/滞后），版面留白充裕但信息密度按页承载完整判断句与依据。
103:- **Hierarchy direction**: 页眉章节带（定位）→ 页标题与判断句（本页结论）→ 主数据区（表格/图表/KPI）→ 口径与状态注解 → 页脚来源行；视线自上而下、自左而右，结论先于依据。
104:- **Composition tendency**: 内容页以"左结论右依据"或"上判断句下数据面"为主；数据页优先整版表格或整版条形几何，配一条窄侧栏放口径说明；问题页采用"问题—数据溯源—影响"三段式对应结构，使来源指向可读。
221:- **Composition**: 上部页标题与判断句；中部四条有界进度轨纵向排列（计划数、完成数、完成率、判定状态同行显示）；右侧窄栏为计划总盘子与口径说明
225:  - 判断句：三年改造任务总体完成九成以上，按统一判定阈值属"基本达标"，尚有 5 个小区在建。

256:- **Composition**: 上部页标题与判断句；中部左侧为瀑布式资金流转几何（五段，正负以语义色区分），右侧竖排四个 KPI（计划总投资、到位率、支出执行率、结余率）；下部为三项比率的分母口径对照行
260:  - 判断句：资金到位九成、支出执行八成六，尚有 5393 万元结余资金未形成实物工作量。
277:  - 判断句：资金缺口全部产生于区级配套与社会、居民出资三个渠道，支出侧提升类执行最慢。
296:  - 判断句：总体满意度 93.8%，其中满意 71.2%、基本满意 22.6%、不满意 6.2%。
313:  - 判断句：满意度总体较高但结构不平衡，三个短板维度全部指向完善类任务与施工期管理。
329:  - 判断句：诉求办结率 85.7%，未办结事项高度集中，前两类占 64.1%。
348:  - 判断句：资金方面的两个问题，一个出在来源结构、一个出在支出进度，直接影响了完工率与提升类任务。
366:  - 判断句：实施与群众工作方面的三个问题，全部能在第一部分完成率与第三部分满意度数据中找到对应项。
388:  - 判断句：五个问题对应七项措施，目标值、时限、责任单位逐条落地。
409:  - 判断句：整改之外同步建立长效机制，并提请评审组审议三项事项。
424:- **Content**: 每页讲稿包含四段——本页判断句复述、数据口径说明（分母与保留位数）、与前后页的呼应关系（尤其问题页须点明数据出处页）、面向专家质询的预备答复要点；所有数值只引用页面已出现的同一口径数据，不引入新数字；公文语体，不使用口语化表达
426:- **Notes style**: formal（公文汇报语体，判断句 + 依据 + 口径 + 请审议）

### Part 4: 三、居民满意度

#### Slide 07 - 三、居民满意度（一）：调查组织与总体结果

- **Audience move**: 从"怀疑满意度是否可信"到"确认第三方调查的样本、方式、口径可核，总体满意度 93.8% 成立"
- **Relationships**: 满意、基本满意、不满意三档为 membership（合计 100%）；满意及以上（93.8%）与不满意（6.2%）为 contrast；调查组织要素（机构、时间、方式、样本）与总体结果为 parent→membership
- **Composition**: breathing 页——左侧大号满意度数字与环形构成，右侧为调查组织与口径四条短陈述，版面留白加倍
- **Title**: 居民满意度调查总体结果
- **Core message**: 第三方调查覆盖 68 个小区、有效问卷 6214 份，总体满意度 93.8%
- **Content**:
  - 判断句：总体满意度 93.8%，其中满意 71.2%、基本满意 22.6%、不满意 6.2%。
  - 调查组织：委托第三方机构（区社情民意调查中心）于 2026 年 6—7 月开展，覆盖全部 68 个改造小区
  - 调查方式与样本：入户问卷与线上问卷并行，发放 6800 份，回收有效问卷 6214 份，有效回收率 91.4%
  - 满意度口径：满意度 =（满意 + 基本满意）÷ 有效问卷 × 100%，分维度满意度使用同一口径；不满意 6.2% 对应 385 份问卷
  - 群众参与：改造方案公示 68 个小区，公示率 100%；召开居民议事会 214 场
  - 评价说明：本页与 P08 分维度结果均来自同一次调查、同一份有效问卷库，不可跨调查混用
- **Visualization**: 满意度构成环形图（satisfaction-donut），子项为三档占比、中心总体满意度数字与图例；Native-ready: satisfaction-donut=yes
- **Data class: scenario**（问卷数、比率、场次与机构名称）

#### Slide 08 - 三、居民满意度（二）：分维度满意度评价

- **Audience move**: 从"接受总体满意度"到"看清七个维度中三项低于 90%，且最低三项与第一部分滞后的分项任务一一对应"
- **Relationships**: 七个维度互为并列 contrast（同一口径、同一问卷库）；四项 ≥90% 与三项 <90% 为 contrast 分组；"加装电梯推进"与 P04 电梯完成率 80.0%、"停车与充电设施"与停车泊位完成率 89.4% 为跨页 link
- **Composition**: 整版横向条形：七条按满意度降序自上而下，条右端标注百分比与判定标签，90% 阈值处一条竖直参考线；下方为短板维度与分项任务的对应行
- **Title**: 分维度满意度评价情况
- **Core message**: 四个维度达到 90% 以上，加装电梯推进 84.6%、停车与充电设施 82.1%、施工期文明管理 79.4% 三项低于 90%，为满意度短板
- **Content**:
  - 判断句：满意度总体较高但结构不平衡，三个短板维度全部指向完善类任务与施工期管理。
  - 分维度满意度（口径：该维度"满意 + 基本满意"占有效问卷比重）：基础设施（水电气路、雨污分流）96.4%，达标；小区环境与绿化 95.1%，达标；房屋本体修缮（屋面、外墙、楼道）93.7%，基本达标；安防与智慧化 92.3%，基本达标；加装电梯推进 84.6%，短板；停车与充电设施 82.1%，短板；施工期文明管理（噪声、扬尘、通行）79.4%，短板
  - 判定阈值与 P02、P04 一致：≥95% 达标、90%（含）—95% 基本达标、<90% 短板
  - 与任务数据对应：加装电梯推进 84.6% ↔ 电梯完成率 80.0%（P04）；停车与充电设施 82.1% ↔ 停车泊位完成率 89.4%、充电设施 92.7%（P04）；施工期文明管理 79.4% ↔ 未办结诉求中施工期噪声扬尘 32 条（P09）
  - 高低差：最高维度与最低维度相差 17.0 个百分点（96.4% − 79.4%）
- **Visualization**: 分维度满意度条形图（dimension-satisfaction-bars），子项为七条降序条形、90% 阈值参考线、判定标签；Native-ready: dimension-satisfaction-bars=yes
- **Data class: scenario**（七个维度比率、差值与对应关系）

#### Slide 09 - 三、居民满意度（三）：居民诉求收集办理情况

- **Audience move**: 从"满意度是一个数字"到"看到 1286 条诉求的办结率 85.7% 与未办结 184 条的集中来源，理解不满意 6.2% 的具体构成"
- **Relationships**: 四类未办结事项为 order（按条数降序）并同属 184 条 membership；累计占比 64.1% 的前两类与 P04 滞后任务、P08 短板维度为 link；已办结与未办结为 contrast
- **Composition**: 左侧为办理总量与办结率 KPI 及四条收集渠道，右侧为帕累托图（四类降序条 + 累计占比折线）；下方为超期办结说明
- **Title**: 居民诉求收集办理情况
- **Core message**: 收集诉求 1286 条、办结 1102 条、办结率 85.7%；未办结 184 条中 64.1% 集中于加装电梯与停车泊位两类
- **Content**:
  - 判断句：诉求办结率 85.7%，未办结事项高度集中，前两类占 64.1%。
  - 收集渠道四类：12345 政务服务热线、小区意见箱、居民议事会、线上平台
  - 办理总量：收集 1286 条，已办结 1102 条，办结率 85.7%（口径：已办结 ÷ 收集总数 × 100%），未办结 184 条
  - 未办结事项构成（条数 / 占未办结比重 / 累计比重，降序）：加装电梯推进慢 68 条 / 37.0% / 37.0%；停车泊位不足 50 条 / 27.2% / 64.1%；配套设施及物业衔接 34 条 / 18.5% / 82.6%；施工期噪声扬尘 32 条 / 17.4% / 100.0%
  - 办理质量：已办结诉求平均办理时限 14.2 天，超期办结 127 条，占已办结 11.5%
  - 溯源提示：前两类未办结事项与 P04 完善类滞后任务、P08 两个短板维度同源
- **Visualization**: 未办结诉求帕累托图（unresolved-pareto），子项为四类降序条、累计占比折线与节点标注；Native-ready: unresolved-pareto=yes
- **Data class: scenario**（诉求条数、比率、时限）

### Part 5: 四、存在问题

#### Slide 10 - 四、存在问题（一）：资金保障与支出进度方面

### Part 5: 四、存在问题

#### Slide 10 - 四、存在问题（一）：资金保障与支出进度方面

- **Audience move**: 从"等待被指出问题"到"看到两个资金类问题均由汇报方主动列出，并逐条标注第二部分的具体比率与金额出处"
- **Relationships**: 问题一、问题二为并列（同属资金方面）；每个问题下"问题表现—数据溯源—造成影响"为 parent→membership 且三段为 order；数据溯源与 P05、P06 的资金比率为 link；造成影响与 P03、P04 的完成率为 link
- **Composition**: 上下两块问题带，每块内部左为问题编号与题名、中为问题表现与数据溯源（引用具体比率并标注出处页）、右为造成影响；块底一条细线指向"来源：第二部分 资金使用情况"
- **Title**: 存在问题（一）：资金保障与支出进度方面
- **Core message**: 两个资金类问题分别来自"到位率 90.0% 的渠道结构"与"支出执行率 86.0% 的进度差"，均可回溯至 P05、P06 数据
- **Content**:
  - 判断句：资金方面的两个问题，一个出在来源结构、一个出在支出进度，直接影响了完工率与提升类任务。
  - 问题一：多元筹资渠道尚未闭合，区级配套与社会、居民出资到位率偏低
  - 问题一数据溯源（P06）：区级财政配套到位率 81.8%（缺口 2140 万元）、管线单位及社会资本到位率 73.0%（缺口 1140 万元）、居民出资到位率 65.8%（缺口 1000 万元），而中央、省级、市级三级补助资金到位率均为 100.0%
  - 问题一造成影响（P03、P04）：整体资金到位率 90.0%；5 个在建小区中 4 个因资金未闭合缓建，直接使小区完工率停在 92.6%
  - 问题二：支出进度滞后于到位进度，结余资金沉淀未形成实物工作量
  - 问题二数据溯源（P05、P06）：支出执行率 86.0%，账面积余 5393 万元、结余率 14.0%；分类支出执行率提升类 75.9%、完善类与前期及管理费 86.0%、基础设施类 89.6%；5393 万元中 3236 万元因竣工结算审计未完成暂不能拨付，占结余 60.0%
  - 问题二造成影响（P04）：提升类支出执行率最低，对应提升类任务完成率最低——社区服务及养老托幼设施 79.2%、智慧安防 89.7%
  - 问题成因（资金侧）：竣工结算审计周期平均 92 天，已审计项目 41 个、占已竣工项目 65.1%，审计滞后是结余沉淀的直接原因
- **Data class: scenario**（问题表述所引全部比率、金额与比例关系）

#### Slide 11 - 四、存在问题（二）：改造实施与群众诉求方面

- **Audience move**: 从"认可资金问题"到"确认实施与群众工作方面三个问题同样有出处，且逐条对应第一部分完成率与第三部分满意度维度、诉求分类"
- **Relationships**: 问题三、问题四、问题五为并列（同属实施与群众诉求方面）；每个问题下"问题表现—数据溯源—满意度呼应"为 parent→membership；问题三与 P04 完成率、P08 短板维度为 link；问题四与 P08 最低维度、P09 施工期诉求为 link；问题五与 P09 物业衔接诉求为 link
- **Composition**: 三栏问题卡横向并列，每卡自上而下为问题编号与题名、问题表现、数据溯源（标注出处页）、满意度或任务呼应；卡底一条统一的"来源指向"细线，分别指向第一部分与第三部分
- **Title**: 存在问题（二）：改造实施与群众诉求方面
- **Core message**: 三个问题分别对应完善类与提升类任务滞后、施工期现场管理不足、改造与管护衔接缺位，出处依次为 P04、P08、P09
- **Content**:
  - 判断句：实施与群众工作方面的三个问题，全部能在第一部分完成率与第三部分满意度数据中找到对应项。
  - 问题三：完善类、提升类任务推进不平衡，滞后项集中在群众最关切事项
  - 问题三数据溯源（P04）：加装电梯完成率 80.0%、社区服务及养老托幼设施 79.2%、新增停车泊位 89.4%、智慧安防 89.7%，均低于总体完工率 92.6%
  - 问题三满意度呼应（P08）：加装电梯推进 84.6%、停车与充电设施 82.1%，为七个维度中最低两项；未办结诉求中电梯与停车两类合计 118 条、占 64.1%（P09）
  - 问题四：施工期现场管理不到位，直接影响群众感受
  - 问题四数据溯源（P08、P09）：施工期文明管理（噪声、扬尘、通行）满意度 79.4%，为全维度最低；未办结诉求中施工期噪声扬尘 32 条、占 17.4%
  - 问题四问题表现：部分项目未落实公示告知、错峰施工与扬尘抑制措施；68 个小区配备现场监督员 42 名，覆盖率 61.8%
  - 问题五：改造与后续管护衔接不够，长效机制尚未建立
  - 问题五数据溯源（P09）：未办结诉求中"配套设施及物业衔接"34 条、占 18.5%
  - 问题五问题表现：63 个已完工小区中 45 个落实物业服务、覆盖率 71.4%，其余 18 个仍由社区代管；后续管护资金渠道未明确
- **Data class: scenario**（问题表述所引全部比率、条数与覆盖率）

### Part 6: 五、下一步计划

#### Slide 12 - 五、下一步计划（一）：整改措施与时限安排

- **Audience move**: 从"看清五个问题"到"确认七项措施逐条对应问题、目标值以现状 → 目标表述、时限与责任单位明确，具备可督办性"
- **Relationships**: 七项措施为 order（按问题一至问题五排列）；每项措施与其对应问题为 link（一一对应，问题三对应措施 3、4、5）；每项措施下"措施内容—目标值—完成时限—责任单位"为 membership
- **Composition**: 整版记录表：六列为序号、对应问题、整改措施、目标值（现状 → 目标）、完成时限、责任单位；对应问题列使用问题编号与语义色标记，与 P10、P11 编号一致
- **Title**: 下一步整改措施与时限安排
- **Core message**: 七项措施逐条对应五个问题，全部目标值以"现状 → 目标"同口径表述，时限最迟不超过 2027 年 6 月底
- **Content**:
  - 判断句：五个问题对应七项措施，目标值、时限、责任单位逐条落地。
  - 措施 1（对应问题一）：报请区政府追加 2026 年度区级配套预算，签订管线单位共建共担协议 3 家，居民出资实行"一小区一方案"分摊｜资金到位率 90.0% → 100%（补齐缺口 4280 万元：区级 2140、社会资本 1140、居民 1000）｜2026 年 10 月底前区级到位、12 月底前社会及居民出资到位｜区财政局、区住建局、各街道
  - 措施 2（对应问题二）：建立"竣工一个、结算一个、审计一个"机制，压缩结算审计周期｜平均审计周期 92 天 → 45 天；支出执行率 86.0% → 98.0% 以上，消化结余 5393 万元｜2026 年 12 月底前｜区审计局、区财政局、区住建局
  - 措施 3（对应问题三）：5 个在建小区实行"一小区一策"清单化推进｜小区完工率 92.6% → 100%（剩余 5 个、36 栋、1600 户、13.1 万平方米）｜2026 年 11 月底前｜各街道、区住建局、代建单位
  - 措施 4（对应问题三）：加装电梯攻坚与停车资源挖潜｜电梯 96 部 → 120 部（完成率 80.0% → 100%）；停车泊位 2860 个 → 3200 个（89.4% → 100%）；充电设施 241 处 → 260 处（92.7% → 100%）｜2027 年 6 月底前｜区住建局、区规划资源分局、各街道
  - 措施 5（对应问题三）：补齐提升类设施短板｜社区服务及养老托幼设施 19 处 → 24 处（79.2% → 100%）；智慧安防 61 个 → 68 个（89.7% → 100%）；绿化及公共空间 14.1 万㎡ → 15.6 万㎡（90.4% → 100%）｜2027 年 6 月底前｜区民政局、区住建局、各街道
  - 措施 6（对应问题四）：施工期文明管理"三个一"（一张告示、一名监督员、一个投诉电话），未办结诉求台账销号｜现场监督员覆盖率 61.8% → 100%；诉求办结率 85.7% → 100%；施工期文明管理满意度 79.4% → 90% 以上｜2026 年 12 月底前｜各街道、区住建局、施工单位
  - 措施 7（对应问题五）："改造 + 物业"衔接，明确管护资金渠道并建立年度回访｜已完工小区物业服务覆盖率 71.4% → 100%（45 个 → 63 个）；总体满意度保持 95% 以上｜2026 年 12 月底前｜区住建局、区房管部门、各街道
  - 表下口径行：目标值一律以"现状 → 目标"表述，现状值取自 P03—P09 同一口径数据，不另设统计范围
- **Visualization**: 整改措施与时限记录表（rectification-record-table），子项为七条措施记录、对应问题标记、时限与责任单位列；Native-ready: rectification-record-table=yes
- **Data class: scenario**（全部目标值、时限、责任单位与协议数量）

#### Slide 13 - 五、下一步计划（二）：长效管护机制与提请审议事项

- **Audience move**: 从"认可整改措施"到"明确三项长效机制与三项提请审议事项，准备作出通过决定"
- **Relationships**: 三项长效机制为并列 membership（管护、评价、监督）；三项提请审议事项为 order（须逐项表决）；总体目标五项比率与 P03—P09 现状值为 link（现状 → 目标）
- **Composition**: 上部为三项长效机制横向并列，中部为总体目标口径带（五项比率现状 → 目标），下部为三项提请审议事项编号列出，收尾一行结束语句
- **Closing impact**: 收束要点为"三项指标一条线：小区完工率 92.6%、资金到位率 90.0%、居民满意度 93.8%；至 2027 年 6 月底分别达到 100%、100%、95% 以上"，并以"以上汇报，提请评审组审议"结束；建议以深藏青底、赭金细线的收尾带承载，与封面形成呼应
- **Title**: 长效管护机制与提请审议事项
- **Core message**: 建立"改造—管护—评价"闭环，提请评审组审议三项事项
- **Content**:
  - 判断句：整改之外同步建立长效机制，并提请评审组审议三项事项。
  - 长效机制一（管护）：完工小区竣工即移交物业服务，管护资金由物业服务费、小区公共收益与财政补贴三渠道明确分担
  - 长效机制二（评价）：每季度开展满意度回访，年度公布改造绩效，回访口径与本次调查一致（满意度 =（满意 + 基本满意）÷ 有效问卷 × 100%）
  - 长效机制三（监督）：资金全过程跟踪审计与按小区公示常态化，公示率保持 100%，审计覆盖率由 65.1% 提升至 100%
  - 总体目标（至 2027 年 6 月底，同口径）：小区完工率 92.6% → 100%；资金到位率 90.0% → 100%；支出执行率 86.0% → 98% 以上；诉求办结率 85.7% → 100%；居民总体满意度 93.8% → 95% 以上
  - 提请审议事项一：同意追加区级配套资金 2140 万元并纳入 2026 年度财政预算
  - 提请审议事项二：同意 5 个在建小区竣工时限调整至 2026 年 11 月底
  - 提请审议事项三：支持将管线单位"共建共担"机制纳入市级文件，明确社会与居民出资分担规则
  - 结束语：以上汇报，提请评审组审议。
- **Data class: scenario**（三项目标比率、审议事项金额与时限）

#### Slide 10 - 四、存在问题（一）：资金筹措与支出进度

- **Audience move**: 从"等待被指出问题"到"看到两个资金类问题均由汇报方主动列出，并逐条标注第二部分的具体比率与金额出处"

- **Title**: 存在问题（一）：资金筹措与支出进度

  - 问题一：资金筹措渠道未闭合，4280 万元缺口集中于三类渠道
  - 问题一数据溯源（P06）：区级配套 81.8%（缺口 2140 万元）；社会资本 73.0%（缺口 1140 万元）；居民出资 65.8%（缺口 1000 万元）
  - 问题一主要表现：区级配套、社会资本、居民出资三类渠道到位率均低于 90.0%，三级财政资金已 100.0% 到位，缺口全部来自上述三类渠道
  - 问题一影响：5 个在建小区尾款、24 部电梯补贴暂无法拨付，直接影响完工率与居民满意度
  - 问题二：支出进度滞后于资金到位，5393 万元结余未形成实物工作量
  - 问题二数据溯源（P05、P06）：支出执行率 86.0%（低于到位率 90.0%）；提升类支出执行率 75.9%（结余 1579 万元）
  - 问题二主要表现：已到位 38520 万元中仅支出 33127 万元，账面积余 5393 万元，其中 3236 万元因竣工结算审计未完成暂不能拨付
  - 问题二影响：提升类支出执行率仅 75.9%，直接拖累社区服务及养老托幼设施 79.2% 的完成率（见 P04）

#### Slide 11 - 四、存在问题（二）：任务推进与居民诉求

- **Audience move**: 从"认可资金问题"到"确认实施与群众工作方面三个问题同样有出处，且逐条对应第一部分完成率与第三部分满意度分项、诉求分类"

- **Composition**: 三条问题带自上而下并列，每条内部为编号徽标与问题题名、通栏"数据溯源"条（标注出处页与具体比率、件数）、左"主要表现"右"影响"两栏；页脚来源行指向 P04、P08、P09

  - 问题四：施工期现场管理不到位，影响居民满意度｜数据溯源（P08、P09）：施工期现场管理满意度 79.4%，为七项最低；施工噪声扬尘未办结 32 件｜主要表现：围挡、降尘、噪声控制及文明施工公示在部分标段未落实｜影响：拉低总体满意度 93.8%，并引发投诉

#### Slide 12 - 五、下一步计划（一）：整改措施与责任分工

- **Audience move**: 从"看清五个问题"到"确认七项措施逐条对应问题、验收口径为可量化比率、时限与责任单位明确，具备可督办性"

- **Title**: 整改措施与责任分工
- **Core message**: 七项措施逐条对应五个问题，验收口径全部为可量化比率并沿用 P02 统一阈值，时限最迟不超过 2026 年 12 月底
- **Content**:
  - 判断句：七项措施逐条对应五项问题，明确责任单位、完成时限与验收口径，比率沿用P02统一阈值。
  - 措施 01（问题一）：追加区级配套资金安排，将 2140 万元缺口纳入年度预算调整方案｜区财政局、区住建局｜2026 年 10 月底｜区级到位率 100.0%
  - 措施 02（问题一）：建立管线单位出资联席会议制度，签订"共建共担"协议并明确付费节点｜区住建局、管线单位｜2026 年 11 月底｜社会资本到位率 95.0%
  - 措施 03（问题一）：推行居民出资先改造后付费及分期缴纳，公示出资标准与使用去向｜街道办事处、社区｜2026 年 12 月底｜居民出资到位率 90.0%
  - 措施 04（问题二）：建立结余资金月调度机制，对 3236 万元待审计资金实行竣工结算限时办结｜区财政局、审计局｜2026 年 11 月底｜支出执行率 95.0%
  - 措施 05（问题三）：加装电梯与停车泊位项目单独建档、单独调度，实行一小区一方案｜区住建局、规划分局｜2026 年 11 月底｜完成率均达 90.0%
  - 措施 06（问题四）：落实文明施工标准，设置公示牌与噪声扬尘监测点，实行投诉 24 小时响应｜区住建局、城管局｜2026 年 10 月底｜施工管理满意度 90.0%
  - 措施 07（问题五）：明确设施移交清单与物业接管主体，同步签订后期管养协议｜区住建局、民政局｜2026 年 12 月底｜设施移交率 100.0%
  - 表下整改要求：上述七项措施自本报告审定之日起执行，每月 5 日前报送进展；验收口径中的比率均按 P02 统一口径计算，达标线 95.0%、滞后线 90.0%，与 P02、P08 判定阈值一致；责任单位为牵头单位，配合单位另行文明确

# Executor Speaker-notes Branch

Conditional late-stage authority for generating or validating the complete speaker-notes document.

**Trigger**: Default loads this after the final quality check when the effective Speaker Notes outcome in `design_spec.md §I` is enabled (a missing legacy outcome defaults to enabled); Quick loads it after its final check when the agent selected notes or narration. Narration requires notes; with notes disabled, do not load this branch or create `notes/total.md`.

## 1. Complete Speaker-notes Document

Write the whole deck to `notes/total.md` in one batch: `# <number>_<page_title>` per page (`# Slide <number>` only for a script written before the roster exists; the splitter takes both), `---` between pages; only the heading is stripped before TTS. `notes_to_audio.py` reads the body verbatim, so write prose only — no list/bullet markup, stage markers, key-point labels, duration lines, or other metadata. Keep one language unless the confirmed contract is bilingual — then every page keeps the same segment order (first language, blank line, second language; narration reads both and doubles the page's time, so notes headed for audio keep one language unless both are meant to be heard); spell out digits or symbols when literal TTS would sound wrong (Chinese "百分之六十八" rather than "68%").

**Pre-SVG narration branch**: when `notes/total.md` already exists from a final/literal script or Quick direct narrated video, validate it instead of regenerating. Retain every word and segment of a final/literal script; agent-authored Quick narration may be repaired only for final-SVG inconsistency and before audio. A `# Slide <number>` heading remains valid until Generate Step 7.1 resolves the roster.

**Length follows content**: size natural sentences to semantic burden — two to five is typical, not a cap; anchor pages may use less and dense pages more. Duration is pacing guidance only: never pad, repeat, compress, or omit meaning to hit it.

## 2. Final-SVG Grounding and Coverage

**Hard rule — the final SVG is the visible page authority**: read every finalized `svg_output/<slide>.svg` in slide order with the active plan/context and approved sources; never write from the outline or core message alone.

Before drafting, internally inventory the visible title/subtitle and every information-bearing direct-root `<g id>` (structured placeholder content counts). Coverage means its unique claim, evidence, example, relationship, qualifier, or implication — not merely its label — enters the narration. For a pre-SVG script, apply the inventory in reverse: every independent visible claim is supported by its script segment; repair the visual page or return to planning for final/literal input, repair the narration before audio for agent-authored Quick narration, and give every spoken idea needing orientation a visible state or explicit speech-only role.

- Text blocks, comparisons, and processes keep every independent fact or relationship; combine related short groups causally or comparatively.
- Charts, tables, and KPIs state the takeaway, decisive values or trend, comparison basis, implication, and material uncertainty — not every axis, row, or cell.
- Quotes keep the decisive clause, material attribution, and relevance. Explain semantic images or text-free diagrams only from the SVG plus plan/source; never infer facts from appearance.
- Speak a source or footer only when attribution, uncertainty, or qualification changes the argument. Omit backgrounds, decoration, chrome, page numbers, and fixed Master/Layout atoms.

Form one coherent argument in intended reading/reveal order — proposition → evidence or mechanism → implication or bridge; DOM order need not be speaking order. A sentence may cover related groups and a complex group may need several sentences, but no independent group disappears to meet a count. Never vocalize IDs, positions, colors, icons, "this card shows" descriptions, or coverage markers.

## 3. Reading Mode and TTS

| `consumption_mode` | Notes emphasis |
|---|---|
| `text` | Interpret and connect a self-contained page; synthesize every independent information group rather than omitting it |
| `balanced` | Connect visible claim and evidence, explain the trade-off, bridge forward |
| `presentation` | Carry reasoning, context, and supporting detail intentionally omitted from the sparse page |

Put transitions naturally in the opening sentence when useful; never label them. When `notes/total.md` is complete, return to Generate Step 7.1 (Default) or `quick-generate.md` §4 (Quick); each route owns splitting and its success criterion.

# 01_cover

各位领导、各位专家，现在由区住房和城乡建设局就老旧小区改造工作情况作汇报。本次汇报的数据期间为二零二三年一月至二零二六年八月，全部数据截至二零二六年八月三十一日，金额单位统一为万元，比率统一保留一位小数。三项总体情况是：三年改造任务的四项总量完成率均落在百分之九十二点五至百分之九十三的区间，按统一判定阈值属基本达标；资金到位率为百分之九十、支出执行率为百分之八十六；居民总体满意度为百分之九十三点八。需要提请评审组重点关注的是，尚未闭合的四千二百八十万元资金缺口，与加装电梯、停车泊位、施工期现场管理三个低于百分之九十的满意度分项，构成本次汇报所列全部五个问题的来源。全篇比率均按同一口径计算，即完成数、到位数、支出数或满意数除以相应的计划数或到位数，再乘以百分之百，不作口径切换。本次汇报不使用实景照片，全部结论由原生表格与图表承载，评审组可对每一格数据逐项核对。

---

# 02_agenda

本次汇报按五个纲目依次进行：一、改造任务完成情况；二、资金使用情况；三、居民满意度；四、存在问题；五、下一步计划。为避免各页数据出现口径分歧，纲要页先把全篇共用的一套统计口径和一套判定阈值固定下来。统计口径为：各项比率等于完成、到位、支出或满意数除以计划或到位数，再乘以百分之百，比率一律保留一位小数，金额一律以万元计。判定阈值为：完成率或满意度大于等于百分之九十五判定为达标，百分之九十含至百分之九十五判定为基本达标，低于百分之九十判定为滞后或短板。这套阈值在改造任务、资金使用和居民满意度三个部分同时适用，第四部分所列每一项问题都标注数据出处页与具体比率，第五部分的验收口径也沿用同一阈值。如评审组对某一项比率的分母有疑问，可直接对照该页底部的口径行，全篇不设第二种算法。

---

# 03_task_overview

先看改造任务完成情况。截至二零二六年八月三十一日，累计开工六十八个小区、开工率百分之百；已竣工验收六十三个小区、小区完工率百分之九十二点六，按统一判定阈值属基本达标。计划总盘子为二零二三至二零二五年、两千年年底前建成的老旧小区，共六十八个小区、五百一十二栋、二点一四万户、建筑面积一百八十六点五万平方米。四项总量指标使用同一口径，即完成数除以计划数乘以百分之百：改造小区计划六十八个、已竣工六十三个，完工率百分之九十二点六；改造楼栋计划五百一十二栋、已完成四百七十六栋，完成率百分之九十三；惠及居民计划二点一四万户、已完成一点九八万户，完成率百分之九十二点五；建筑面积计划一百八十六点五万平方米、已完成一百七十三点四万平方米，完成率百分之九十三。进度轨上的标尺同时标注了百分之九十的滞后线、百分之九十五的达标线和百分之百，四条完成率均落在百分之九十至百分之九十五的基本达标区间内，因此总体判定为基本达标，而不是达标。尚未竣工的五个小区涉及三十六栋、一千六百户、十三点一万平方米，占计划小区数的百分之七点四。此处需要说明口径：完工率指已通过竣工验收的小区数占计划改造小区数的比例，在建指已开工未竣工，两者不重复计算；数据来自改造工作台账与竣工验收备案表。

---

# 04_task_detail

在总体完成率之下，九项分项任务的进度并不均衡。基础设施类两项：水电气路及雨污分流覆盖六十八个小区，已完成六十三个，完成率百分之九十二点六，基本达标；光纤及五代移动通信覆盖六十八个小区，已完成六十六个，完成率百分之九十七点一，是九项中唯一达标的一项。完善类四项：加装电梯计划一百二十部、完成九十六部，完成率百分之八十；新增停车泊位计划三千二百个、完成二千八百六十个，完成率百分之八十九点四；电动自行车充电设施计划二百六十处、完成二百四十一处，完成率百分之九十二点七；无障碍及适老化改造计划一百八十处、完成一百六十三处，完成率百分之九十点六。提升类三项：社区服务及养老托幼设施计划二十四处、完成十九处，完成率百分之七十九点二；智慧安防覆盖六十八个小区、完成六十一个，完成率百分之八十九点七；绿化及公共空间计划十五点六万平方米、完成十四点一万平方米，完成率百分之九十点四。汇总起来是达标一项、基本达标四项、滞后四项，四项滞后任务全部集中在完善类与提升类，其中加装电梯百分之八十和社区服务及养老托幼设施百分之七十九点二最低。判定标准与前页一致，大于等于百分之九十五为达标，百分之九十含至百分之九十五为基本达标，低于百分之九十为滞后；正是这四项低于百分之九十的分项，使总体完工率停在百分之九十二点六而未能达标，也是第四部分问题三的直接依据。

---

# 05_fund_overview

再看资金使用情况。计划总投资四万二千八百万元，实际到位三万八千五百二十万元，到位缺口四千二百八十万元，资金到位率百分之九十；已支出三万三千一百二十七万元，支出执行率百分之八十六；账面积余五千三百九十三万元，结余率百分之十四。资金流转按五段呈现：从计划总投资四万二千八百万元出发，减去到位缺口四千二百八十万元，得到实际到位三万八千五百二十万元；再减去已支出三万三千一百二十七万元，余下账面积余五千三百九十三万元。按已到位资金除以已完成的一万九千八百户计算，户均投入一点九万元。这里必须把三个比率的分母讲清楚，因为它们并不相同：资金到位率的分母是计划总投资，即三万八千五百二十除以四万二千八百；支出执行率的分母是实际到位资金，即三万三千一百二十七除以三万八千五百二十；结余率的分母同样是实际到位资金，即五千三百九十三除以三万八千五百二十。三个比率分母不同、不可相互替代，但都保留一位小数，全篇一致。按同一判定阈值，到位率百分之九十属基本达标，支出执行率百分之八十六低于百分之九十，属滞后，这一落差是第四部分问题二的来源。数据来自专项资金决算表与财政拨付台账。

---

# 06_fund_detail

资金缺口产生在哪几个渠道，这一页逐项列出。资金来源六渠道中，中央补助资金七千七百零四万元、省级补助资金四千六百二十二万元、市级财政资金一万一千五百五十六万元，三级财政资金均百分之百到位，差额为零。缺口全部来自另外三个渠道：区级财政配套计划一万一千七百七十万元、到位九千六百三十万元，到位率百分之八十一点八，缺口二千一百四十万元；管线单位及社会资本计划四千二百二十二万元、到位三千零八十二万元，到位率百分之七十三，缺口一千一百四十万元；居民出资计划二千九百二十六万元、到位一千九百二十六万元，到位率百分之六十五点八，缺口一千万元。三项合计正好是四千二百八十万元，与来源小计的到位率百分之九十相互印证。支出侧按四类列示：基础设施类安排一万八千四百九十万元、支出一万六千五百六十四万元，执行率百分之八十九点六；完善类含加装电梯安排一万一千五百五十六万元、支出九千九百三十八万元，执行率百分之八十六；提升类安排六千五百四十八万元、支出四千九百六十九万元，执行率百分之七十五点九，为四类最低；前期及管理费安排一千九百二十六万元、支出一千六百五十六万元，执行率百分之八十六。支出小计为安排三万八千五百二十万元、支出三万三千一百二十七万元，结余五千三百九十三万元。表中需要说明两处口径：来源组的执行数指实际到位数、执行率即到位率，分母为计划数；支出组的执行数指已支出数、执行率为支出执行率，分母为该类资金安排数，四类安排数合计等于已到位资金三万八千五百二十万元，因此不会出现支出超过到位的情况。资金监管方面，六十八个小区全部纳入专户核算、专款专用，覆盖率百分之百；已开展全过程跟踪审计四十一个项目，占已竣工项目的百分之六十五点一；资金使用情况按小区公示六十八个，公示率百分之百。结余的五千三百九十三万元中，有三千二百三十六万元因竣工结算审计未完成暂不能拨付，占结余总额的百分之六十，这一点将在问题二中作为直接原因引用。

---

# 07_satisfaction_overview

第三部分是居民满意度。本次调查委托第三方机构于二零二六年七月一日至八月十五日开展，采取入户走访与线上问卷并行的方式，覆盖全部六十八个改造小区，每小区随机抽取一百户，共发放问卷六千八百份，回收六千五百三十二份，其中有效问卷六千二百一十四份，有效回收率百分之九十一点四，无效问卷三百一十八份，均为填答不完整。总体结果为：满意四千四百二十四人、占百分之七十一点二；基本满意一千四百零五人、占百分之二十二点六；不满意三百八十五人、占百分之六点二；总体满意度即满意与基本满意之和占有效问卷的比重，为百分之九十三点八。口径需要明确两点：总体满意度等于满意加基本满意人数除以有效问卷数乘以百分之百，下一页各分项满意度使用完全相同的公式，只是题项不同；总体满意度是对改造工作的整体评价，与分项满意度分属不同题项，二者不能相互替代，也不宜简单相加或相减。三档占比合计为百分之百，人数合计为六千二百一十四人，与有效问卷数一致，可逐项核对。

---

# 08_satisfaction_dimensions

分项满意度按同一口径、同一份有效问卷库计算，七个分项由高到低为：基础设施百分之九十六点四，环境绿化及公共空间百分之九十五点一，房屋本体修缮百分之九十三点七，安防及智能化改造百分之九十二点三，加装电梯百分之八十四点六，停车泊位及充电设施百分之八十二点一，施工期现场管理百分之七十九点四。按统一阈值判定，前两项高于达标线百分之九十五，分别为达标，高出一点四个和零点一个百分点；房屋本体修缮与安防及智能化改造落在百分之九十至百分之九十五之间，为基本达标，分别低于达标线一点三个和二点七个百分点；加装电梯、停车泊位及充电设施、施工期现场管理三项低于滞后线百分之九十，判定为滞后，分别低五点四个、七点九个和十点六个百分点，图中竖直虚线即为百分之九十的滞后线。三个滞后分项与前面的任务数据一一对应：加装电梯满意度百分之八十四点六，对应加装电梯完成率百分之八十；停车泊位及充电设施满意度百分之八十二点一，对应停车泊位完成率百分之八十九点四和充电设施完成率百分之九十二点七；施工期现场管理满意度百分之七十九点四为七项最低，对应未办结诉求中施工噪声扬尘三十二件。口径与前页完全一致，即该分项满意与基本满意人数除以有效问卷六千二百一十四份乘以百分之百，达标线百分之九十五、滞后线百分之九十，与纲要页和分项任务明细页使用同一套阈值。

---

# 09_complaint_pareto

居民诉求办理情况直接反映不满意的百分之六点二由什么构成。全期共受理居民诉求一千二百八十六件，已办结一千一百零二件，办结率百分之八十五点七，未办结一百八十四件；办结率的口径为已办结件数除以受理件数乘以百分之百。未办结的一百八十四件按件数降序分为四类：加装电梯进度慢六十八件，占百分之三十七，累计百分之三十七；停车泊位不足五十件，累计百分之六十四点一；设施移交与物业衔接三十四件，累计百分之八十二点六；施工噪声扬尘三十二件，累计百分之百。前两类合计一百一十八件、占未办结诉求的百分之六十四点一，说明未办结事项高度集中，而不是分散在各类问题上。这一结果与前面两部分互为印证：加装电梯进度慢和停车泊位不足，正对应分项满意度中百分之八十四点六和百分之八十二点一的两个滞后分项，也对应分项任务中完成率百分之八十和百分之八十九点四的两项滞后任务；施工噪声扬尘三十二件对应施工期现场管理百分之七十九点四的最低满意度；设施移交与物业衔接三十四件则指向改造与后续管养的衔接问题。数据来自一千二百三十四号热线工单、居民议事会记录及诉求办理台账，四类件数相加等于一百八十四件，与未办结总数一致。

---

# 10_problems_funding

第四部分列出五个问题，其中资金方面两个，全部由第二部分的资金数据直接导出，逐项标注出处。问题一是资金筹措渠道未闭合，四千二百八十万元缺口集中于三类渠道。数据溯源为资金来源明细页：区级配套到位率百分之八十一点八、缺口二千一百四十万元，社会资本到位率百分之七十三、缺口一千一百四十万元，居民出资到位率百分之六十五点八、缺口一千万元。主要表现是这三类渠道到位率均低于百分之九十，而三级财政资金已百分之百到位，缺口全部来自上述三类渠道。影响是五个在建小区的工程尾款和二十四部电梯的补贴暂无法拨付，直接影响完工率与居民满意度。问题二是支出进度滞后于资金到位，五千三百九十三万元结余未形成实物工作量。数据溯源为资金总体页的支出执行率百分之八十六、低于到位率百分之九十，以及资金来源与支出构成页的提升类支出执行率百分之七十五点九、结余一千五百七十九万元。主要表现是已到位三万八千五百二十万元中仅支出三万三千一百二十七万元，账面积余五千三百九十三万元，其中三千二百三十六万元因竣工结算审计未完成暂不能拨付。影响是提升类支出执行率最低，直接拖累社区服务及养老托幼设施百分之七十九点二的完成率。两个问题的关系需要说明：问题一出在来源结构，问题二出在支出进度，到位率与执行率之间四个百分点的落差，就是资金既没筹齐、也没花出去的症结所在，因此第五部分的措施一、二、三针对问题一，措施四针对问题二。

---

# 11_problems_impl

实施与居民诉求方面三个问题，同样逐项可回溯，出处依次为分项任务明细、分项满意度和未办结诉求分布三页。问题三是提升类与完善类任务推进不均衡。数据溯源为：加装电梯完成率百分之八十、新增停车泊位百分之八十九点四、社区服务及养老托幼设施百分之七十九点二、智慧安防百分之八十九点七，以及分项满意度中加装电梯百分之八十四点六、停车泊位百分之八十二点一。主要表现是四项滞后任务全部集中在完善类与提升类，基础设施类已完成。影响是居民最关心的出行与养老需求未同步兑现。问题四是施工期现场管理不到位，影响居民满意度。数据溯源为施工期现场管理满意度百分之七十九点四、为七个分项中最低，以及未办结诉求中施工噪声扬尘三十二件。主要表现是围挡、降尘、噪声控制及文明施工公示在部分标段未落实。影响是直接拉低总体满意度百分之九十三点八，并引发投诉。问题五是改造与后续管养衔接不畅。数据溯源为设施移交与物业衔接未办结三十四件、诉求办结率百分之八十五点七，以及社区服务及养老托幼设施完成率百分之七十九点二。主要表现是已建成的十九处社区服务及养老托幼设施未及时移交运营。影响是设施闲置风险上升，居民获得感打折扣。三个问题与前两个资金问题合起来共五项，分别指向资金、任务、管理、衔接四个环节，第五部分的七项措施按此逐项对应。

---

# 12_measures

第五部分 first 是整改措施与责任分工。七项措施逐条对应五个问题，每一项都明确责任单位、完成时限和可量化的验收口径，验收比率沿用纲要页的统一阈值。措施一对应问题一，追加区级配套资金安排，将二千一百四十万元缺口纳入年度预算调整方案，由区财政局、区住建局牵头，二零二六年十月底前完成，验收口径为区级到位率百分之百。措施二对应问题一，建立管线单位出资联席会议制度，签订共建共担协议并明确付费节点，由区住建局与管线单位负责，二零二六年十一月底前完成，验收口径为社会资本到位率百分之九十五。措施三对应问题一，推行居民出资先改造后付费及分期缴纳，公示出资标准与使用去向，由街道办事处和社区负责，二零二六年十二月底前完成，验收口径为居民出资到位率百分之九十。措施四对应问题二，建立结余资金月调度机制，对三千二百三十六万元待审计资金实行竣工结算限时办结，由区财政局、审计局负责，二零二六年十一月底前完成，验收口径为支出执行率百分之九十五。措施五对应问题三，加装电梯与停车泊位项目单独建档、单独调度，实行一小区一方案，由区住建局、规划分局负责，二零二六年十一月底前完成，验收口径为两项完成率均达到百分之九十。措施六对应问题四，落实文明施工标准，设置公示牌与噪声扬尘监测点，实行投诉二十四小时响应，由区住建局、城管局负责，二零二六年十月底前完成，验收口径为施工管理满意度百分之九十。措施七对应问题五，明确设施移交清单与物业接管主体，同步签订后期管养协议，由区住建局、民政局负责，二零二六年十二月底前完成，验收口径为设施移交率百分之百。整改要求是：七项措施自本报告审定之日起执行，每月五日前报送进展；验收口径中的比率均按纲要页统一口径计算，达标线百分之九十五、滞后线百分之九十；表中责任单位为牵头单位，配合单位另行文明确。这样安排的考虑是，目标值全部落在与现状同一口径的比率上，评审组可以直接用现状值与目标值作差核验进度。

---

# 13_mechanism_requests

整改之外，同步建立四项长效机制。第一，资金保障长效化，将区级配套、管线单位及居民出资纳入年度预算与合同管理，实行到位率月通报，对应问题一。第二，支出进度闭环管理，建立结余资金台账与月度调度机制，竣工结算审计限时三十个工作日办结，对应问题二。第三，居民全程参与机制，改造前问需、改造中问计、改造后问效，分项满意度低于百分之九十的项目一律回头看，对应问题四。第四，改造与管养衔接，改造方案同步编制后期管养方案，明确物业接管主体与经费来源，设施建成即移交，对应问题五。同时提请评审组审议三项事项：一，追加区级配套资金，恳请区政府同意将二千一百四十万元区级配套缺口纳入年度预算调整方案，十月底前拨付到位；二，顺延在建项目工期，恳请同意五个在建小区完工时限顺延至二零二六年十一月底，并按月报送进度；三，支持管线单位共建共担，恳请将管线单位共建共担出资机制纳入市级文件，明确付费节点与比例。需要说明的是，五项验收比率的目标值已在整改措施页按同一口径给出，本页不再另设一套目标数据，以免出现两种口径。以上汇报，请予审议。

#### Step 7.2 — Build the Self-Contained SVG Preview

```bash
python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/finalize_svg.py <project_path>
```

**Success criterion**: `svg_final/` holds one self-contained preview per slide. Its absence never blocks 7.3.

#### Step 7.3 — Export the Native PPTX

| Effective decision | Command |
|---|---|
| Speaker Notes `enabled` | `python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/svg_to_pptx.py <project_path>` |
| Speaker Notes `disabled` | `python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/svg_to_pptx.py <project_path> --no-notes` |

| Decision | Flag |
|---|---|
| Explicit editable Chart/Table delivery decision, or a structured `chart` / `table` placeholder slot | Append `--native-charts-and-tables` (markers, templates, semantic tables, and imported charts never activate it; formulas are always native) |
| Final checker reports oversized images | Append `--image-sizing display` |
| Preserved or produced `animations.json` | Keep the base command; the exporter reads the sidecar |
| Deck-wide motion setting | Append the resolved [`animations.md`](../references/animations.md) flags |
| Explicit Custom Animations disable | Keep the sidecar and append `-a none` |
| Explicit all-motion disable | `--no-animations` |
| Final Stage-2 `false` | Neither flag |
| Conversion trace | Do not add `--conversion-trace` to every base export; an explicit `--conversion-trace <path>` writes to that destination instead of the default |

Sound: the optional post-motion pass is [`animations.md`](../references/animations.md) §2.2. For a narrated MP4, [`generate-audio`](stages/generate-audio.md) owns the delivery choice.

**Success criterion**: the command exits 0 and produces `exports/<project_name>_<timestamp>.pptx`, `validation/<project_name>_<timestamp>.report.json` with `passed` or `passed-with-warnings`, and `validation/<project_name>_<timestamp>.trace.json` when `--conversion-trace` was enabled. The exporter itself requires the current matching `final` quality report and exits nonzero on a missing, unreadable, unsupported, non-final, blocking, stale, or unverifiable one. Read the compact `[POSTFLIGHT]` receipt (`status`, `quality_gate`, slide count, warning counts, paths), disclose material warnings, and never `cat` the full report on success. Retain the report path for a later `deck_motion` handoff; postflight proves the package, not a later MP4 audio track.

### Revision Round (delivered project)

A delivered project that comes back with a change stays in this route; planning does not restart. Act at the owning layer. A wording change, an added condition, or a re-titled page edits the SVG, then its §IX block, `notes/total.md`, and every page that repeats the line (a chapter page's route, the contents page). A page inserted, dropped, or moved renumbers the roster first — files, footers, contents-page numbers, §IX blocks, `page_rhythm` / `page_visualizations` rows, `animations.json` keys, `notes/total.md` headings, same-deck hyperlink targets — then authors or removes the page; whatever the moved page carried moves with it: a Morph `from` names the new preceding page and a "next chapter" preview group follows its boundary.
